raw.description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission

Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences. Across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH), massive retailers and e-commerce brands are sitting on print catalogs that need to move digital.

Your mission as Senior Account Executive is simple: take complete ownership of the DACH territory, aggressively prospect into mid-market and enterprise retail accounts, and turn relationships into closed ARR. We work 80% asynchronously and judge you entirely on pipeline velocity and quota achievement—not on the number of hours you sit on Zoom.

What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days)

We don't measure you by years of experience; we measure you by outcomes. Here is what you will achieve in your first 3 months:

  • Day 30: You have completely mastered the Publitas value proposition, understand our core retail/e-commerce personas, and have built a targeted list of your top 50 high-priority DACH accounts.

  • Day 60: You have independently built and launched multichannel outbound sequences. You are running discovery calls completely unassisted and have successfully moved your first self-generated opportunities into the negotiation stage (at least 1).

  • Day 90: Your outbound engine is predictable. You have built an active pipeline worth 3x your quarterly target and closed your first mid-market DACH deal.

Requirements

The DNA of a Sales Executive at Publitas (Culture & Ownership)

  • Founder-Level Ownership: You treat the DACH territory like your own independent business. You don't wait around for inbound marketing leads, sales enablement decks, or a manager to tell you who to call. You map the territory, identify the decision-makers, and architect the outbound strategies required to break into enterprise accounts from scratch.

  • A Continuous Growth Mindset: Modern B2B sales cycles shift rapidly, and legacy sales scripts no longer work on smart e-commerce buyers. You are constantly experimenting with new outreach mediums, testing messaging hooks, and studying the digital retail landscape. When a deal stalls, you don't blame the product, you treat it as a data point to dissect, learn from, and iterate your approach for the next pitch.

  • High Autonomy, Zero Ego: In a remote-first, asynchronous sales team, there is nowhere to hide behind "busywork" or metrics vanity. You thrive on being judged entirely by your pipeline health and closed ARR. You don't need continuous synchronous cheerleading; your motivation is entirely internal.

What We Offer You to Win

  • Transparent & Uncapped Compensation: A competitive base salary of €60k - €85k (geo-bracketed to your location) + an uncapped Variable Compensation Plan (VCP) where you are rewarded heavily for target overachievement.

  • True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

  • Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

  • Modern Sales Stack & Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

  • Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

  • Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

The Non-Negotiables

  • Native/Fluent German & Professional English: You will be closing deals in German; you will be collaborating with the global team in English.

  • Proven B2B SaaS Closing Record: You have spent at least 3+ years managing full-cycle sales cycles (from cold outreach to signed contract) directly within the DACH retail, e-commerce, or digital marketing spaces.

  • Outbound Execution: You do not wait for inbound marketing leads. You know how to multi-thread accounts and hunt your own pipeline.

  • AI-First Execution: We do not scale headcount to solve manual problems. You must have a proven track record of working in an AI-first way, leveraging generative AI tools to hyper-personalize outbound messaging, automate account research, summarize call data, and accelerate your sales velocity.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

  • Stakeholder-Management: Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatungen, Wirtschaftsprüfungen, CFOs und Finanzbehörden

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in HGB sind ein Must-have. Grundlagen in IFRS/ anderen GAAP und Konsolidierung sind ein Nice-to-have

WOFÜR WIR STEHEN:Wir existieren, um unternehmerische Handlungsfähigkeit verantwortungsvoll und wirksam zu stärken. raw.description:
SaaStorm is a fully remote organic growth agency for B2B SaaS, headquartered in London with a team spread across Europe. Since founding in 2024, we've grown to work with SaaS companies from pre-seed through Series C, and we're approaching €1.5M ARR.

What makes us different is the bet we've made: search is changing, and the companies that win the next five years will be the ones cited by LLMs, not just ranked by Google. We've built our delivery model around that thesis, combining traditional organic growth with AEO/LLM visibility work, and we report on pipeline impact rather than vanity metrics.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for producing high-quality content that supports our SEO and content strategy - helping drive measurable outcomes such as sign-ups, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and long-term brand value for both SaaStorm and our B2B SaaS clients.

You’ll work closely with our strategists and delivery team to turn briefs, research, and positioning into clear, compelling, conversion-aware content that meets quality standards and deadlines.

Tasks

  • Own content writing for 2-4 B2B SaaS clients (you'll be writing for the same clients mostly, so you'll be able to learn their product, ICP and use cases).
  • Produce 15-17 long-form articles/month for our B2B SaaS clients (primarily SEO/AEO-focused content)
  • Write content that is clear, well-structured, and aligned with the brief, brand voice, and target audience
  • Apply SEO writing best practices (search intent alignment, on-page structure, internal linking notes, basic keyword integration)
  • Conduct research and incorporate credible sources, product context, and customer pain points into your writing
  • Collaborate with the team to clarify briefs, messaging, and scope when needed
  • Use our tools (e.g., SurferSEO, ClickUp, Slack, Google Docs) to manage drafts, feedback, and revisions
  • Edit and revise based on feedback, ensuring content meets SaaStorm quality standards
  • Experiment with and responsibly use AI tools where helpful (e.g., for outlines, idea generation, or efficiency) while maintaining originality and accuracy

What we care about:

  • Impact: pipeline, sign-ups, revenue
  • Enjoyment: you like the work + the people you do it with
  • Flexibility: async where possible, trust by default, no micromanagement

Requirements

Please, only apply if you're based in the EU/UK.

  • Experience: 3+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in the SaaS space.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with Semrush, Google Search Console, SurferSEO, and tools like AirOps are a plus.
  • Writing Excellence: Ability to produce engaging, high-quality, and error-free content.
  • Organization: Exceptional time management and a proven ability to meet deadlines.
  • Communication: Confident in interviewing subject matter experts to produce insightful, well-researched content.
  • SaaS Knowledge: Familiarity with SaaS products, audiences, and buyer journeys.

Benefits

  • Flexible Hours: You manage your schedule as long as deliverables are met and you’re available for essential calls (usually within CET 9–5)
  • Remote-First: Our team is fully distributed but highly collaborative.
  • In-person offsites: Once a year, we fly the entire team for 3-4 days to the same country (September 2026 - Amsterdam!), so we can spend time together & just have fun without Slack.
  • High Standards, Fast Feedback: We operate with clear expectations, direct communication, and iterative improvement
  • Outcome-Oriented: We care about content that performs - not just content that ships
  • Paid Holiday Leave: You can take up to 20 days of paid holiday leave per year, plus national public holidays applicable in your country of residence.
  • Professional Development: SaaStorm will co-fund a relevant course or certification (up to €500 per year), subject to prior approval and relevance to your role and our client work.

About PlanITROI

For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped organizations maximize the value of their retired technology through secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), lifecycle management, reverse logistics, refurbishment, repair, redeployment, and re-marketing services. Every device we recover creates financial value for our clients while extending the life of technology and helping provide affordable devices to individuals, schools, nonprofits, and businesses around the world. PlanITROI is a recognized leader in sustainable IT lifecycle solutions, helping enterprise organizations improve financial performance, strengthen security, and advance ESG initiatives through our circular economy model.

Today, we are building something even greater!

The world’s greatest Repair, Refurbishment, and Lifecycle Services organization!

At the center of that vision is our state-of-the-art Center of Excellence in Youngsville, North Carolina. A high-performance operation where technology, automation, engineering, compliance, and people come together to transform retired and underutilized IT devices into enterprise-grade, re-certified technology solutions.

But PlanITROI is more than an ITAD company. We are redefining how the world’s largest channel organizations, OEMs, GSIs, MSPs, VARs, and enterprises think about lifecycle value, sustainability, circularity, risk reduction, and technology access.

Our work strengthens ESG outcomes, recovers value, reduces operational and data-security risk, and creates new revenue opportunities across the IT lifecycle.

As we continue scaling globally, we are investing heavily in strategic partnerships, alliance ecosystems, executive engagement, and category leadership. We are seeking visionary, execution-driven leaders who want to help shape the future of lifecycle services, circular technology, and enterprise channel transformation.

If you are energized by building strategic partnerships, influencing enterprise ecosystems, creating category-defining messaging, and driving growth through world-class channel and alliance marketing, we invite you to help build that future with us.

Sales Development and Executive Outreach Specialist

PlanITROI is hiring Sales Development and Executive Outreach Specialist to work directly with our CEO, and our Chief Strategy Officer. This person will help drive outbound sales activity, activate executive relationships, follow up on qualified leads, and make sure new business appointments are scheduled every week.

The right person for the role is proactive, organized, persistent, professional, and comfortable communicating with U.S executives, business owners, referral partners, and prospects. They are independent thinkers with proven experience and require minimal direction, someone who takes an assignment, follows through, and reports back without needing to be managed step by step.

You will support the CEO and CSO by helping turn relationships, introductions, qualified leads, and targeted prospects into scheduled appointments and active business opportunities.

You will use Apollo.io, Salesforce, LinkedIn, email, phone calls, and AI-enabled tools to research prospects, identify and engage B2B contacts, manage outreach, document activity, and complete follow-up.

This is a remote role, based in Latin America in Eastern Standard Time.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work directly with the CEO and CSO to organize, prioritize, and execute outbound sales outreach.
  • Research companies, decision-makers, executives, referral sources, and relationship paths.
  • Keep all active prospects, B2B contacts and accounts, and follow-up items organized and current.
  • Use Apollo.io to identify, enrich, organize, and prioritize leads.
  • Use Salesforce to track every call, email, LinkedIn touch, task, note, meeting outcome, and follow-up.
  • Send polished, personalized outbound emails.
  • Make professional calls to schedule appointments and advance conversations.
  • Use LinkedIn for prospect research, direct outreach, engagement, and thought leadership support.
  • Follow up on PlanITROI’s executive network, warm relationships, referrals, inbound leads, and lead generation team leads.
  • Coordinate meeting scheduling, confirmations, reminders, and next-step communication.
  • Take meeting notes when needed and follow through until next steps are completed.
  • Prepare prospect briefs, account research, call summaries, and meeting notes.
  • Track opportunities through appointment setting, post-meeting follow-up, proposal support, contract progress, and handoff to Client Success.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, lead generation, and Client Success to keep opportunities moving.
  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism with executive relationships and strategic opportunities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

What Success Looks Like:

  • 5-10 Qualified new business appointments are scheduled every week.
  • PlanITROI’s executive network is researched, organized, contacted, and followed up on.
  • Qualified leads receive fast, professional follow-up.
  • Salesforce is accurate, current, and complete.
  • Every prospect has a clear next step.
  • Post-meeting follow-up happens quickly.
  • No qualified lead, relationship, or opportunity falls through the cracks.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in outbound sales support, appointment setting, lead follow-up, business development, sales research, executive outreach, B2B contact management, or executive sales assistance.
  • Strong experience with email, phone, LinkedIn, and CRM-based follow-up.
  • Experience using Apollo.io or similar prospecting tools for research, contact identification, lead enrichment, and list building.
  • Strong Salesforce proficiency, including activity logging, task management, account updates, contact updates, notes, and follow-up tracking.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally with U.S. and Global executives.
  • Strong business writing skills with the ability to write clear, concise, personalized emails.
  • Professional phone presence and confidence calling executives, decision-makers, referral partners, and prospects.
  • Strong research skills and ability to quickly understand companies, contacts, industries, and business opportunities.
  • Expert experience using LinkedIn for sales outreach, research, direct communication, and relationship development.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, ownership, and follow-through.
  • Experience working directly with Executives, founders, business owners, executives, or senior sales leaders preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, and related productivity tools.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for research, writing, prospecting, and workflow efficiency preferred.

Why Join PlanITROI?

You will work directly with professional direct and very accountable CEO and Chief Strategy Officer on business development that matters. While your friends, family and significant others have a job that pays the bills, you will be helping PlanITROI create new relationships, expand its sales pipeline, grow strategic accounts, and advance our mission of Changing Lives with Affordable Technology.

Without you helping we cannot advance our mission, if you are proactive, polished, sales-driven, highly organized, and excellent at follow-up, this role gives you the opportunity to make a direct impact every week.

Senior Product Manager, Data & AI (Document Intelligence)
Client opportunity via G2i · Remote (continental US, Eastern Time) · DC/Metro area preferred

About this opportunity
G2i is hiring on behalf of one of our clients, a fast-growing, DC-based government services firm. Since 2009 they have helped federal agencies and large government primes in three areas: research and data analysis, advanced data science, and strategic services. They currently support several analytics and research programs across HHS. The team is collaborative and small enough that your work is visible, and they take work-life balance seriously.

You'd be hired through G2i and work embedded with the client's team.

The role
You'll own the product roadmap for the client's document intelligence platform. You'll turn customer and reviewer needs into clear, testable requirements and make sure each problem is fixed in the right place. That could be the UX, the source data, the extraction pipeline, the model, the search logic, the thresholds, or the business rules.

This role suits a product leader who knows that AI products need measurable definitions of quality: accuracy, false-positive rates, reviewer effort, evidence requirements and operational performance.

What you'll do

  • Own the roadmap and priorities across data engineering, data science, backend, search and frontend teams

  • Lead discovery with clients and internal stakeholders using prototypes, demos and working software

  • Turn business needs into requirements, user stories, business rules and measurable acceptance criteria

  • Define requirements for document processing, alerts, scoring, evidence presentation, search, review workflows and source traceability

  • Work with data scientists on evaluation datasets, model metrics, confidence thresholds, and acceptable false-positive and false-negative rates

  • Work with data engineers on ingestion, normalization, metadata, lineage, processing completeness and data quality

  • Diagnose whether an issue comes from the UI, data, model, pipeline, search, thresholds or business rules

  • Favor reusable platform capabilities over one-off client customizations

  • Coordinate release readiness, client demos and structured feedback

  • Measure accuracy, completeness, reviewer effort, latency, reliability, adoption and cost

  • Communicate priorities, tradeoffs and limitations clearly to clients and internal teams

What you bring

  • Senior PM experience delivering AI/ML, data-intensive, search or workflow products

  • Experience prioritizing work across data, ML, backend and frontend teams

  • A track record of discovery driven by prototypes or demos

  • Skill turning business needs into detailed, technical, testable requirements

  • Experience defining acceptance criteria for probabilistic features such as model outputs, alerts, recommendations or rankings

  • A solid grasp of data pipelines, APIs, data quality, system dependencies and model behavior

  • Close working experience with data scientists, data engineers, software engineers and UX

  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, writing and decision-making

Requirements

  • Authorized to work in the US, with 3+ consecutive years living in the US

  • Able and willing to obtain a Public Trust clearance

Nice to have

  • Document intelligence, OCR, semantic or vector search, generative AI, or human-in-the-loop workflows

  • Products built on AWS (e.g. S3, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Bedrock, SageMaker, Textract)

  • Regulated, healthcare, medical-device or other high-stakes products

  • Model governance, explainability, evidence traceability and reviewer workflows

  • Supporting multiple clients while keeping one coherent, reusable roadmap

raw.description:
Solution Engineering – EMEA

Department: Solutions Engineering, EMEA

Reports to: Lead Solutions Engineering, EMEA

Location: Remote

About the Role

As a Solution Engineer, you will play a key role in helping customers understand how technology can solve complex business and quality challenges within the highly regulated Life Sciences industry.

You will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams throughout the customer engagement and sales lifecycle. Your role is to understand the customer’s business, processes and objectives, translate these into meaningful solution approaches, and clearly communicate how our solutions can deliver measurable value.

You will combine business acumen, technical understanding, industry knowledge and consultative skills to guide customers from initial discovery through solution definition and demonstration.

You don’t just demonstrate what the product can do — you help customers understand what the right solution should look like.

Key Responsibilities

  • Apply knowledge of Life Sciences, pharmaceutical quality processes and regulated environments when developing solution approaches.
  • Understand how customer requirements relate to relevant quality, compliance and regulatory expectations.
  • Consider areas such as GxP, data integrity, validation and controlled processes when discussing potential solutions.
  • Help customers understand how digital solutions can support their quality processes within a regulated environment.
  • Stay current with industry trends, digital transformation initiatives and emerging technologies relevant to Life Sciences.
  • Partner closely with Sales to develop solution strategies for complex opportunities.
  • Support opportunity qualification by assessing customer requirements, solution fit, complexity, dependencies and potential risks.
  • Participate in customer presentations, executive briefings, workshops and technical discussions.
  • Partner with Account Executives to understand customer objectives, challenges, business processes and desired outcomes.
  • Lead and support discovery sessions with prospective and existing customers.
  • Engage directly with business, technical and quality stakeholders to clarify requirements and identify opportunities.
  • Design and deliver tailored, compelling solution demonstrations based on customer-specific business processes and requirements.
  • Develop realistic use cases, demonstration scenarios and solution narratives that clearly communicate business value.
  • Lead solution and value workshops with customer stakeholders.
  • Translate complex product capabilities into clear and relevant business outcomes.

raw.description:
Are you ready to make a lasting impact on literacy?

At Really Great Reading, we are building a bright, diverse, and passionate team dedicated to leading the industry in improving literacy scores nationwide. With nearly two decades of leadership bringing the Science of Reading to thousands of schools, we design innovative products, training, and materials that transform how educators teach and how students learn. Here, we empower our team with the tools, support, and professional growth opportunities they need to thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment—where your work truly makes a difference.

Sr. Revenue Systems Administrator

Location: Remote (USA)

Reports to: Director of Revenue Operations

Why This Role Matters

Behind every successful partnership with a school district is a revenue engine that runs seamlessly.

From a district's first interaction with Really Great Reading through quoting, contracting, reporting, and ongoing support, every touchpoint depends on reliable systems, accurate data, and efficient processes.

The Senior HubSpot Administrator plays a critical role in ensuring our revenue technology ecosystem enables our teams to do their best work. By owning and optimizing HubSpot, this role empowers Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to spend less time managing systems and more time supporting educators and improving literacy outcomes.

Success in this role means building scalable, reliable HubSpot environment that streamlines operations, maintains trusted data, and gives leadership the reporting it needs to make confident decisions.

The Role

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented HubSpot Administrator to manage, optimize, and support our HubSpot CRM environment. This role will serve as the primary administrator for HubSpot, ensuring our systems, workflows, integrations, and data are operating efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidate has deep hands-on experience administering HubSpot, is comfortable working with our internal IT team on integrations, and is eager to grow into supporting adjacent revenue systems (like DealHub) over time. This individual will play a key role in maintaining system integrity, supporting end users, and enabling our go-to-market teams through reliable automation, trusted data, and strong day-to-day administration.

What You’ll Do

HubSpot Administration

  • Manage and maintain HubSpot CRM, including contacts, companies, deals, tickets, workflows, custom properties, and reporting.
  • Configure and optimize sales, marketing, and service hubs.
  • Create and maintain automated workflows, lead routing rules, email templates, forms, and sequences.
  • Monitor data quality, deduplication, and CRM governance standards.
  • Develop dashboards and reports to support business performance and decision-making.
  • Manage integrations between HubSpot and other business systems, in partnership with our internal IT team.

User Support & Training

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for HubSpot and DealHub users.
  • Troubleshoot user issues and coordinate vendor support when necessary.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions.
  • Promote best practices and increase system adoption across teams.

Nice to Have: Broader Revenue Systems Exposure

These skill sets aren't required, but there’s a real opportunity to grow into them as bandwidth allows.

  • Exposure to DealHub or another CPQ platform (pricing rules, quote templates, approval workflows).
  • Experience supporting process documentation and ad hoc business analysis.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Sales Operations, or related field.
  • 3-5+ years of experience administering HubSpot CRM.
  • Strong understanding of CRM, data analytics, sales operations, and quote-to-cash processes.
  • Experience with workflow automation, reporting, and system integrations.
  • Proficiency in data management and CRM governance.
  • Strong communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • HubSpot Certifications.
  • Experience administering DealHub or similar CPQ platform.
  • Experience integrating HubSpot with other business systems (e.g., DealHub, NetSuite, Google Workspace)
  • Strong SQL, Python, or other data analysis/BI tool experience.
  • Experience supporting Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Go-to-Market teams

What We Offer

We take care of the whole person because we believe that when our team thrives, so do the students and educators we serve. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive 401(k) with company matching
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Paid Time Off to support rest, renewal, and life outside of work
  • Employee Discount Program and partner savings
  • Ongoing professional development and learning investment
  • Wellness initiatives designed to support physical, mental, and emotional well-being
  • Evolving benefits shaped by team member voice and values

Physical Requirements

This is a fully remote role. Team members work primarily at a computer and regularly engage in video conferencing, document review, and digital collaboration. The ability to work at a screen for extended periods, use standard input devices, and participate in virtual meetings is required.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Really Great Reading is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performing workplace that reflects the diverse students, educators, and communities we serve. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation, improve learning outcomes, and advance educational equity nationwide.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

description: WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DOMosaic Clinical Technologies™ is pioneering a new imaging paradigm—shifting radiology from reactive diagnostics to proactive, decision-driven care.

raw.title: Director, Clinical AI Operations
raw.excerpt: WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DOMosaic Clinical Technologies™ is pioneering a new imaging paradigm—shifting radiology from reactive diagnostics to proactive, decision-driven care.
raw.description:
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO
Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is pioneering a new imaging paradigm—shifting radiology from reactive diagnostics to proactive, decision-driven care. Through our AI-native platform, MosaicOS™, we unite fragmented technologies into a single, intelligent ecosystem designed to help clinical teams work faster, think smarter and deliver better care.
Built cloud-native and designed for continuous iteration, MosaicOS™ is engineered to solve the industry’s most pressing challenges. Our platform expands clinical capacity, improves diagnostic quality by combining human expertise with AI, and turns operational complexity into strategic advantage through seamless integration or replacement of legacy imaging systems.
Every AI tool within MosaicOS™ is validated across tens of millions of exams to ensure safe, reliable and meaningful clinical impact. With a ransomware-resistant design and built-in redundancy, our platform is designed to ensure continuity of care and protect both patients and operations.
Mosaic Clinical Technologies™ is building technology that evolves with clinicians to advance clinical excellence and improve patient outcomes. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of medical imaging, join us!
POSITION SUMMARY:
  • Serve as SME on clinical workflows and AI-enabled tools, supporting end users and guiding stakeholders on adoption and best practices.
  • Design, test, and validate clinical and technical workflows to ensure AI solutions are operationally and clinically ready for deployment.
  • Build and optimize scalable processes for clinical AI programs, monitoring performance, utilization, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead cross-functional coordination across engineering, data science, operations, vendors, and clients to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
  • Manage end-to-end project execution, including planning, documentation, resource allocation, timelines, and stakeholder communication.
  • Translate clinical needs into technical requirements (and vice versa) while driving solution design, integration, and continuous improvement.
  • Support AI adoption through user training, documentation, troubleshooting, and ongoing engagement with clinicians, end users, and external clients.
DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
  • 5+ years’ experience supporting radiology and/or related clinical workflows, software & technologies.
  • 5+ years’ experience managing clinical and/or technical projects.
  • Experience working with FDA clearance is highly preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare or technology related field preferred.
  • Proven project leader with experience managing complex, multi-project portfolios (AI/IT/Data) across internal teams, vendors, and external clients using Agile and Waterfall methodologies.
  • Strong cross-functional communicator who bridges clinical and technical domains, presents effectively to diverse audiences, and delivers training programs that drive AI adoption.
  • Highly organized, solutions-oriented self-starter with leadership presence—skilled in prioritization, delegation, risk management, and driving operational efficiency at scale.
WHY MOSAIC CLINICAL TECHNOLOGIES:
  • Competitive Benefits package – Eligibility starts the month after hire, with tiered options to choose from.
  • Compensation Reviews, Career Growth Opportunities
  • Flexible Remote Schedules
  • Generous PTO Plans and Paid Holidays
COMPENSATION:
The salary range for this position is $120,000.00 - $140,000.00. Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).
Mosaic Clinical Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. MCT is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.
CCPA Notice: When you submit a job application or resume, you are providing Mosaic Clinical Technologies with the following categories of personal information that the Company will use for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for employment: (1) Personal Identifiers; and (2) Education and Employment History. Mosaic Clinical Technologies participates in E-verify.
Beware of Fraudulent Messages: Mosaic Clinical Technologies or Radiology Partners will never request payment, banking or other financial information in exchange for interviews or as part of the hiring process. Additionally, we will not send checks for deposit into your bank account at any stage of recruitment. All communication during the interview and hiring process should come from an email address ending in “@radpartners.com.” If you suspect you are receiving a fraudulent job offer or solicitation from Radiology Partners or one of our local practices, please email to notify our team.

Company Description

CyberArrow is your top solution to stress-free cyber security compliance and awareness. We are trusted by the world's biggest brands including but not limited to: Emirates Airlines, American Express, Bupa and others. We help companies with their security compliance requirements and programs. CyberArrow is currently investing significant resources to deliver successful revenue increase across its Enterprise GRC and Awareness Platform offerings.

Job Description

  • Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects.
  • Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Automate test cases and contribute to test automation frameworks.
  • Perform regression testing and ensure software stability.
  • Analyze requirements and design documentation to ensure comprehensive test coverage.
  • Document testing processes and results.
  • Stay updated with industry best practices and emerging technologies in QA.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in software testing methodologies and tools.
  • Proficiency in programming/scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Attention to detail and ability to work independently.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium or others.

Key Outcomes & Metrics

  • Team and company progress is measured in monthly OKRs.

What you’ll get

Perks

  • Outcome based work environment.
  • A competitive compensation.

Culture

  • Ability to implement your ideas - fail fast, learn faster.
  • A culture that empowers you everyday to take ownership.

Workplace

  • 100% remote work. You only need to have a laptop and active internet connection to join CyberArrow.
  • An opportunity to join the founding team of a hyper growth rocketship.
  • Work with founders who are the only official UAE Delegates in the Global ISO working group being responsible for writing global cyber security standards.
  • Culturally diverse team from multiple countries yet focused towards one mutual goal.
  • An environment that encourages quick learning and merit-based exponential growth.

raw.title: Senior Strategic Growth Partner
raw.excerpt: The RoleThis is a senior client-facing role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of strategy, growth, sales, and execution.
raw.description:
The Role

This is a senior client-facing role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of strategy, growth, sales, and execution.

You will work directly with founders and business owners, understand their business in depth, identify what is holding growth back, and help them decide what to do next.

You are not here to simply manage a relationship.

You are here to become a trusted partner in the growth of the business.

That means understanding the client's goals, offer, market, acquisition strategy, sales process, delivery model, current constraints, and commercial priorities - then helping them turn that into a clear plan of action.

In some conversations, you will be helping a founder sharpen their positioning.

In others, you will be diagnosing why pipeline is weak, why sales are not converting, why execution is stalling, or where the next growth opportunity sits.

Your job is to create clarity. To tell clients what matters now. To show them what needs to happen next. And to make sure the right actions actually happen.

This is not a traditional Customer Success role.

It is a role for someone who wants to become an exceptional commercial operator by working closely with ambitious founders and helping them solve real business problems.

The Opportunity

You will have exposure to a large number of businesses, markets, offers, sales models, and growth challenges.

That creates an unusually steep learning curve.

Instead of spending years inside one company solving one set of problems, you will see patterns across dozens of businesses and develop the judgment to quickly understand:

  • What is actually holding growth back
  • What is noise and what matters
  • Where the highest-leverage opportunity is
  • What the founder should focus on now
  • What should be stopped
  • What should be doubled down on
  • How strategy should translate into execution

Over time, the expectation is that clients see you as someone whose judgment they trust.

Someone who can walk into a complicated situation, understand it quickly, simplify it, and give them a clear direction forward.

If you want to build serious capability in growth strategy, founder communication, sales, operations, and commercial decision-making, this role gives you the environment to do it.

What You Will Own

Become a True Growth Partner to Clients

You will work closely with founders to understand the business beyond surface-level account updates.

You will build a clear picture of:

  • Their business model
  • Target market
  • ICP
  • Offer
  • Pricing
  • Positioning
  • Acquisition channels
  • Sales process
  • Current pipeline
  • Delivery model
  • Team capacity
  • Growth goals
  • Immediate constraints

From there, you will help determine the highest-priority actions required to move the business forward.

Advise, Don't Just Support

We are not looking for someone who simply responds to questions.

We want someone capable of leading the thinking.

You should be comfortable saying:

"This is the problem I think we need to solve first."

"This is where I think you're focusing on the wrong thing."

"This is the strategy I would recommend."

"This is what I would do over the next 30 days."

"This is what needs to happen before we scale."

You will challenge clients when needed, simplify decisions, and help them avoid wasting time on low-leverage work.

Your value comes from your judgment, not just your responsiveness.

Turn Strategy Into Action

Good advice without execution is useless.

Every strategic conversation should translate into clear priorities.

You will help clients move from broad goals to focused execution:

  • Define the objective
  • Identify the constraint
  • Decide the strategy
  • Break it into clear actions
  • Assign ownership
  • Set timelines
  • Review what happened
  • Adjust based on results

You should naturally reduce complexity rather than add to it.

If a client has fifteen things they could be doing, your job is often to help them identify the two or three that actually matter.

Help Clients Build Revenue

You will think commercially.

That means understanding the complete journey from market to revenue:

Positioning → Acquisition → Conversations → Pipeline → Sales → Revenue → Delivery → Expansion

You will help clients understand where that journey is breaking down.

For example:

If acquisition is weak, you investigate the offer, market, message, and channel.

If leads are coming in but deals are not closing, you look at qualification, sales process, follow-up, positioning, and pricing.

If sales are happening but delivery is becoming difficult, you help identify what needs to change operationally.

You should be comfortable moving across the business rather than treating growth as a single function.

Work Across Growth Channels

Depending on the client, you may be advising across areas such as:

  • Cold email
  • Outbound
  • Paid acquisition
  • Offer development
  • ICP and positioning
  • Lead generation
  • CRM and pipeline
  • Sales process
  • Follow-up
  • Proposal strategy
  • Pricing
  • Go-to-market
  • Operational priorities
  • AI implementation and services

You do not need to personally be the world's best practitioner in every function.

You do need enough commercial understanding to identify what is working, what is not, ask the right questions, and make good strategic recommendations.

Lead High-Level Client Conversations

You will spend significant time speaking directly with founders and senior operators.

These are not scripted check-ins.

The conversations should be valuable enough that a founder would pay for the thinking itself.

You will:

  • Review business performance
  • Analyse what has changed
  • Identify opportunities
  • Diagnose problems
  • Challenge assumptions
  • Set priorities
  • Recommend strategy
  • Help unblock decisions
  • Create accountability
  • Keep momentum high

The standard is not whether the meeting happened.

The standard is whether the meeting changed what happens next.

Own the Bigger Picture

Clients may have multiple people supporting different parts of their business.

Your role is to maintain the full commercial picture.

You should understand what everyone is working on, how it connects to the overall strategy, and whether the combined effort is actually moving the client toward their objective.

If teams become disconnected, priorities conflict, or something important is falling through the cracks, you take ownership of resolving it.

The client should feel like they have one clear strategic partner who understands the whole business.

Identify Risk Before It Becomes a Problem

Strong operators notice problems early.

You should recognise when:

  • A client is losing momentum
  • Execution has stalled
  • The strategy is not producing results
  • Expectations have become misaligned
  • Lead flow is weak
  • Sales follow-up is poor
  • Internal delivery is becoming a blocker
  • The client is focusing on the wrong priorities
  • Trust is beginning to decline

Then act.

Do not wait for a formal escalation.

Part of being a trusted partner is being willing to address uncomfortable realities before they become larger problems.

Skills & Competencies

Commercial Judgment

You understand how businesses grow and make money.

You can connect strategy to revenue and distinguish between activity and actual commercial progress.

Strong Diagnostic Ability

You can listen to a complicated situation and quickly work out what the underlying issue is.

You separate symptoms from root causes.

Strategic Thinking

You can move between the big picture and immediate execution.

You know how to turn an ambitious goal into the next few actions that actually matter.

Founder-Level Communication

You can communicate confidently with intelligent, ambitious, demanding people.

You are comfortable challenging ideas without becoming confrontational.

You can give clear advice even when it is not what the client hoped to hear.

High Ownership

You do not wait to be told what to do when something is obviously not working.

You investigate, decide what needs to happen, and move it forward.

Structured Execution

You are excellent at turning conversations into decisions, priorities, actions, owners, and timelines.

Curiosity

You genuinely enjoy understanding businesses.

You want to know why an offer works.

Why one market responds differently from another.

Why one sales process converts and another does not.

Why certain founders execute faster than others.

That curiosity compounds into judgment.

AI Fluency

You actively use AI to improve your thinking and output.

You should use AI to analyse businesses, prepare for conversations, research markets, structure plans, review performance, document decisions, and increase the quality and speed of your work.

The Person We Want

This role is best suited to someone who wants to accelerate their career by taking on real responsibility.

You want to become the kind of person founders trust when making important decisions.

You want to develop judgment, not just knowledge.

You want to understand how businesses grow from the inside.

You are excited by the idea of working across many different companies, seeing patterns quickly, and becoming better at solving commercial problems every week.

You do not want to spend your career running scripted calls.

You want to sit across from a founder, understand what they are trying to build, and help them build it.

You Will Probably Not Fit If

  • You want a traditional Customer Success role
  • You prefer being given the answer rather than finding it
  • You are uncomfortable advising people more senior than you
  • You avoid giving direct recommendations
  • You prefer following scripts to thinking independently
  • You enjoy relationship management but are less interested in business strategy
  • You are uncomfortable discussing revenue, sales, pricing, or performance
  • You need very clear boundaries around your responsibilities
  • You focus heavily on activity rather than outcomes
  • You are looking for a low-pressure role with a predictable learning curve

Requirements

Experience

  • 7+ years in consulting, growth, client strategy, account management, sales, operations, or a senior client-facing role
  • Experience working directly with founders, executives, or business owners
  • Strong commercial understanding and the ability to think across acquisition, sales, and delivery
  • Experience helping businesses solve growth or execution problems
  • Strong understanding of B2B go-to-market
  • Direct exposure to areas such as outbound, sales, offer creation, paid acquisition, pipeline management, consulting, or agency delivery
  • Experience operating in fast-moving environments where judgment matters more than rigid process

Benefits

What You Get

  • Fully remote
  • Full-time role at a profitable, bootstrapped company
  • Direct access to ambitious founders and business owners
  • Exposure to a wide variety of companies, markets, and growth problems
  • The opportunity to build deep skill across strategy, acquisition, sales, operations, and AI
  • Significant autonomy and ownership
  • Direct access to senior leadership
  • A role where your judgment and capability can grow quickly
  • Performance-based progression into leadership, strategy, operations, or broader commercial ownership
  • Independent Contractor Agreement

This is an opportunity to become much more than an account manager.

Done well, this role develops you into the kind of commercial operator who can walk into almost any business, understand what matters, and help the founder decide what to do next.

Job Summary:

The Principal Compliance Specialist serves as the organization's subject matter authority for a defined regulatory domain or program area, independently managing complex and enterprise-scope matters from initiation through resolution without a defined playbook to follow. Operating across a large healthcare system, the Principal Specialist produces the analytical conclusions, regulatory interpretations, investigative findings, and policy recommendations that Directors and Executives rely on to make high-stakes compliance decisions. This role is the right fit for a seasoned compliance professional who wants to do the most intellectually demanding individual contributor work in the field, with direct visibility to senior leadership and enterprise-level impact, without moving into people management.

Job Duties:

  • Independently manages a defined compliance program area from annual work plan development through execution, monitoring, reporting, and closure without requiring supervisory structuring of tasks or priorities.
  • Analyzes complex and novel regulatory requirements, federal and state guidance documents, and enforcement trends; produces written regulatory impact analyses identifying the specific operational change required, the responsible business unit, and the recommended implementation timeline.
  • Designs and executes monitoring and auditing activities for assigned program areas, including selection of review methodology, sample design, data collection, findings documentation, and written presentation of results to the Manager or Director.
  • Leads compliance investigations assigned at the Principal level by coordinating information collection, conducting or managing interviews, documenting evidentiary findings, and producing a written investigative report that includes substantiation analysis and recommended corrective action for Director review.
  • Develops, drafts, and revises compliance policies, standards, and procedures for review and approval by the Director or Associate Officer; ensures each policy accurately reflects current regulatory requirements and is written to be operationally executable by the functions it governs.
  • Identifies compliance gaps through proactive program assessment; documents each gap with a risk severity rating using the function's established scoring methodology, a root cause analysis, and a recommended remediation plan with an assigned implementation owner.
  • Manages cross-functional compliance projects by developing the project work plan, assigning tasks to participating staff, tracking progress against established milestones, and escalating risks or delays to the Manager or Director with a documented options analysis.
  • Prepares written materials, including regulatory analysis memos, program status reports, and executive summary decks that communicate findings and recommendations to Director and VP-level leadership in a form suitable for executive review without additional editing.
  • Contributes to the annual enterprise compliance risk assessment by identifying and documenting risks within the assigned program area, scoring each risk using the function's established severity and likelihood methodology, and submitting a completed risk register section to the Director by the designated deadline.
  • Monitors published regulatory guidance, enforcement actions, and material industry developments relevant to the assigned domain on an ongoing basis; produces a written impact summary identifying the operational effect and recommended organizational response within 30 days of material issuance.
  • Serves as the primary compliance point of contact for assigned operational business partners; manages the relationship by conducting regular touchpoints, communicating program requirements, and tracking open compliance commitments to closure.

Work is typically performed in an office environment. Accountable for satisfying all job specific obligations and complying with all organization policies and procedures. Job Title: Health Systems Associate Director - St Louis, MO

Job Location: Remote - MO

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

The Health Systems Associate Director (HSAD) position is a field leadership role supporting Sun’s Branded Portfolio in the Oncology, Immunology, and Dermatology Market. This position will identify and develop working relationships with key decision makers in the operations and management of designated targeted IDN’s and potentially additional organized customer groups to ensure patients have access to Sun Branded products. These accounts will include the Nation’s Leading Academic Centers, Centers of Excellence, Organized Super-Groups and other entities of value. The HSAD will place themselves in a position to influence and educate the formulary and/or purchasing decision-making processes at all levels, including Medical, Clinical, Policy, and C-Suite executives. This position will be responsible for implementing the company’s strategic objectives and provide cross-functional leadership and collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders to drive appropriate Sun Brand utilization and revenue growth.

Key Responsibilities:

The Health Systems Associate Director is responsible for calling on identified IDN’s and other organized customer groups (as needed) in a specified geography to support Sun’s Oncology, Immunology, and Dermatology Brands and are responsible for the following:

  • Identify and develop working relationships with key decision makers within these corporate accounts from a clinical, administrative, pharmacy, and C-Suite perspective.
  • Educate the formulary and decision making process at all levels. Gain acceptance and support of Sun Pharma Products both clinically and administratively by key decision makers / stakeholders to ensure patients have access to care within their systems.
  • Analyze and understand Brand opportunity for targeted accounts and work appropriately with cross-functional partners (Field Sales Managers, FRM Managers, Field Medical, PRD, etc.) to optimize access and utilization for Sun Branded Products within targeted accounts and to ensure pull through across the system.
  • Expert knowledge of the B&B process, Medicare Part B, 340B, as well as commercial reimbursement, specialty pharmacies and identifying alternative sites of infusion are required.
  • Develop and execute Strategic Account Plans in cooperation with relevant functions (MSLs, Medical Affairs, Marketing and Pricing)
  • Conduct quarterly business reviews with key account personnel.
  • Establish strong relationships with cross-functional partners’ and provide on-going clear communication to ensure clarity of access positions and support pull-through efforts. Operate consistently with Healthcare Compliance guidelines. Arrange for Senior Management customer interactions as needed.
  • This is a field based position, requiring significant travel to assigned IDN Accounts and field based/home office based meetings and trainings.

Education & Qualifications:

  • A minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree is required. A Master’s Degree is preferred.
  • 3+years of account management experience or other Managed Markets experience is preferred.
  • Experience working in channels such as large Payers, national and regional health plans, state and local governments, PBM's, SPP's and Physician Medical Groups.
  • Prior experience with director and senior level executives within the assigned geographical area preferred. Potential candidates must have a solid understanding of key public and private Payer policy infrastructure, payment methodologies, coverage, health policy trends and current business challenges.
  • Proven teamwork and collaboration skills with a demonstrated track record leading highly matrixed, cross-functional work teams comprised of high-level managers and executives.
  • Analyzes and uses qualitative and quantitative data and incorporates understanding into decision criteria.
  • Able to effectively manage competing priorities with strong sense of urgency.
  • Able to act as an advocate for the Sun Pharmaceuticals and the corporation’s commitment to providing excellent customer service.
  • Creative / innovative thinker with an understanding of legal / regulatory environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly developed analytical skills with demonstrated ability to conceptualize issues and synthesize data to provide strategic direction.
  • Acts as a role model for others in line with Sun’s values.

The presently-anticipated base compensation pay range for this position is $143,500 to $235,500. Actual base compensation may vary based on a number of factors, including but not limited to geographical location and experience. In addition, this position is part of IC Commission Plan and is eligible for the Receipt of Company Vehicle. Employees are eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs which include medical, dental and vision coverage; life insurance; disability insurance; 401(k) savings plan; flexible spending accounts; and the employee assistance program. Employees also receive various paid time off benefits, including vacation time and sick time

As a Partner Account Executive at WEX, you are the accountable owner of the post-sale partner relationship, responsible for delivering value, strengthening partnerships, and ensuring long-term partner success. This role requires extreme ownership—you are responsible for protecting and growing your accounts, minimizing attrition, driving renewals, and ensuring a world-class partner experience.


You will serve as the strategic partner and trusted advisor to your partners—deeply understanding their goals, operations, and industry—while aligning WEX’s solutions to help them grow and succeed. Your impact will directly influence account growth and increased annual recurring revenue (ARR) for WEX. Through proactive engagement, strategic planning, and product enablement, you will drive adoption, retention, and long-term loyalty.


How You'll Make an Impact

🔹 Strategic Partnership & Ownership

  • Serve as the primary post-sale point of contact and strategic advisor for assigned partner accounts
  • Build deep, long-term relationships based on trust, transparency, and shared goals
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of each partner’s business, KPIs, and growth strategies
  • Champion partner success through regular touchpoints, planning sessions, and business reviews

🔹 Account Growth & Revenue Impact

  • Take full ownership of account growth and retention, directly contributing to increased ARR for WEX
  • Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities by aligning WEX capabilities to emerging partner needs
  • Lead the renewal process, ensuring timely execution and clear demonstration of value
  • Use strategic planning and quarterly business reviews to showcase ROI and build expansion roadmaps

🔹 Product Enablement & Adoption

  • Guide partners through best practices and advanced product features to maximize value
  • Develop enablement plans that support partner-specific business outcomes
  • Drive consistent product utilization to ensure adoption and prevent churn

🔹 Service Ownership & Escalation Leadership

  • Act as an escalation point of accountability for issue resolution and partner satisfaction
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Product, Tech, Service, Compliance, Legal, etc.) to resolve concerns quickly and completely
  • Prevent reactive service by identifying friction points early and proactively with cross functional teams to addressing them

🔹 Communication & Advocacy

  • Proactively share relevant product updates, enhancements, and news
  • Gather and communicate customer feedback to internal stakeholders to influence product direction and service improvements
  • Represent the voice of the partner within WEX

🔹 Operational Execution & Reporting

To the bank, transactions look normal,controlsnever fire, and just like that the money is gone.

CYBERA goes upstream to disrupt thescameconomy. Our agenticscamdefense platform engages scammers at scale,turnthem into informants, andcapturethe mule accounts they plan to use before anyone loses money. Banks, insurers, and payment companies use CYBERA to know their bad accounts before money moves in and freeze payments to bad accounts before money heads out. When scammers are successful, CYBERA's agentic response engine traces, freezes, and helps recover funds, dramatically improving consumer outcomes. Leading banks, insurers, and crypto exchanges use CYBERA to cut fraud losses, speed up victim recovery, and turn everyscamattempt into intelligence that protects the next customer.

Every Cyberian is a disruptor, using AI for good to stop financial crime at scale. If taking on this$450 billionproblem sounds like your kind of work,we'dlike to meet you. Learn more at.

About the role

As a Principal Data Analyst, you’ll turn massive volumes of messy scam, money mule, and internet signals across a multitude of channels into meaningful insights that guide investigations, improve systems and inform product decisions. You will work closely with engineering, product and operations to strengthen how CYBERA understands, measures, and scales its fraud and mule intelligence capabilities. Qualifications

Position Description:

We are seeking a Senior Recruiter who thrives on the fast pace of full-cycle recruiting, someone who can juggle a full slate of open reqs without losing precision or creativity. You'll act as a trusted, consultative partner to hiring managers, running sourcing, screening, and candidate management day in and day out. You hold a rigorous bar for how candidates think, collaborate, and execute, and know how to balance that standard with the urgency of a scaling business, shaping how every candidate experiences our brand from first touchpoint to hire. You bring serious full-cycle recruiting chops, a sharp eye for data, and the kind of sourcing creativity that finds exceptional talent others overlook. Most importantly, you believe that who you hire defines the culture and capability of everything a company builds. If you're energized by the challenge of attracting top-tier talent to a product that's transforming an industry, this role was made for you.

Why Tenna?

At Tenna, we believe the best is right in front of all of us, and that each day holds more potential than the one before. We believe that every new discovery can lead to something better than we thought possible. When we boil it down, the top five qualities that define the Tenna Team are quality-obsessed, gritty, continuous learners, collaborative problem solvers, and just plain awesome. Sound like you? Join us as we empower our customers to control their mixed assets anytime, anywhere, on one comprehensive platform. Apply now!

Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of open requisitions, partnering closely with hiring managers to understand role needs and deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate pipeline.
  • Collaborate with leadership and Hiring Managers to anticipate talent needs and establish proactive sourcing pipelines.
  • Analyze external labor market data and internal talent gaps to develop sourcing strategies by function and level.
  • Conduct quarterly reviews of hiring needs and adjust the strategy to support seasonal or shifting demand.
  • Partners with the Director of Human Resources to identify opportunities for internal mobility and succession-based hiring pipelines.
  • Own and optimize the candidate journey from sourcing to onboarding, ensuring every touchpoint reflects Tenna’s core values positively.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and up-to-date ATS, including but not limited to candidate notes, disqualification reasons, job statuses, and tagging, to ensure accurate reporting and compliance.
  • Ensure that all recruiting data is clean and auditable. Conduct periodic ATS audits and train stakeholders on best practices for data hygiene as needed.
  • Maintain SLAs with hiring managers, facilitate kickoff and debrief sessions, and provide training to ensure best-in-class (consistent and objective) hiring practices.
  • Identify, coordinate, and execute recruiting event attendance, including career fairs, virtual hiring days, university meetups, hackathons, and community initiatives.
  • Build relationships with external organizations, boot camps, etc. to expand event reach and increase candidate flow.
  • Build and maintain a database of high-potential passive candidates through research, networking, and direct sourcing efforts.
  • Utilize Boolean search techniques to identify and engage passive candidates through advanced search logic.
  • Leverage social media platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, X/Twitter, GitHub, Slack communities) to source talent and promote open roles.
  • Engage with niche and industry-specific job boards to attract candidates with specialized skill sets.
  • Promote our referral programs to drive warm leads and expand candidate reach through internal networks.
  • Proactively create and adapt candidate outreach strategies on sourcing platforms to improve engagement and pipeline performance.
  • Ensure all recruiting activities comply with relevant employment laws, including EEO, OFCCP, and GDPR/CCPA, as applicable.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in full-cycle talent acquisition.
  • Experience supporting a high-growth and/or fast-paced company is strongly preferred.
  • Proven success hiring across technical, corporate, and high-volume roles.
  • Proven success in strategic sourcing, candidate evaluation, and stakeholder partnership across multiple functions and levels.
  • Hands-on experience using ATS platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, or iCIMS to manage workflows, data, and compliance.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze recruiting funnel data and use insights to recommend and implement process improvements.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Suite: Excel, Word, PPT, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and sustain effective relationships with internal stakeholders, hiring managers, and external partners.
  • Diligent, thorough, and detail-oriented.
  • Proven ability to manage confidential and sensitive information.
  • Deadline-driven with a strong sense of urgency and accountability to meet business hiring goals.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and consult across all levels of the organization.
  • Experienced in handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion and integrity.
  • Self-starter with a service-oriented mindset, capable of adapting to shifting priorities and taking ownership of outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a business-related major is required or equivalent.

Benefits, Perks, & Additional Information:

  • Full-time opportunity.
  • Location: Remote - United States. East coast preferred.
  • Travel is required, up to 20%.
  • Competitive compensation packages offered.
  • Opportunities for growth and personal development within highly dynamic team.
  • Robust, low-cost benefit packages offered.
  • Benefit coverage begins the first date of employment.
  • Paid Time Off and Volunteer Time Off offered.
  • Dependent Care offered.
  • 401k match.
  • Employee referral bonuses.
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Tenna is committed to building a diverse team. We welcome different perspectives and opinions to foster innovation, authenticity, and excellence across all parts of our company, and are committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

Why Moore TK?

Together with our partner bunch capital we are building the next generation of fund services: technology-driven, automated and seamlessly integrated with product & engineering.
For our VC & PE clients, we deliver high-quality investor reporting and financials – fast, standardized, audit-proof. We rely on modern tools, clean data models and automation instead of Excel overload.
We develop an integrated end-to-end operating model (accounting, reporting, tax) – standardized, quality-assured and knowledge-driven – thereby creating a foundation for scalable, future-proof fund services.

Your mission
You will take responsibility for fund accounting & investor reporting for selected VC/PE funds – on time, accurately and Invest Europe compliant. You are more than just a numbers expert: you ensure transparency and trust among fund managers, LPs and investment teams, making the success of our funds visible.
With your eye for efficiency, you will actively drive the automation and digitization of our processes and work with us to shape the next stage of development for our services. Quality, responsibility and progress are not buzzwords to you, they’re what truly motivate you.
Sounds like you? Then help us shape the future of fund accounting!

Tasks

What You’ll Do

  • Investor Reporting I Preparation of accurate investor reports including performance metrics (IRR, TVPI, DPI, RVP, etc.), NAV and carried interest calculations. Ensuring compliance with the Invest Europe guidelines and handling ad-hoc enquiries.
  • Annual Financial Statements & Audit I Responsibility for annual financial statements including notes, close coordination with auditors, monitoring of quality and timelines as well as risk-oriented reviews.
  • Accounting & Quality Controls I Conduct reviews of accounting data, reconciliations and valuation checks, while continuously improving our quality assurance process.
  • Data & Automation I Collaboration with product and engineering teams to further standardise and automate our processes.
  • Advisory & Reviews I Support portfolio valuations, waterfall calculations and reviews of capital calls, distributions and management fee calculations.
  • Stakeholder Management I Proactive, reliable communication with GPs, LPs and internal teams (operations, tech).
  • Tax Collaboration I Work closely with the tax team on tax-related matters and ensure consistency between accounting, tax ledger and investor reporting.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Qualification I Degree in accounting, finance or controlling (or equivalent) and at least 5 years of relevant experience in fund accounting/administration (alternative investments). Experience in integrated setups involving operations, accounting/reporting and tax is a plus.
  • Expertise I Solid knowledge of Local GAAP and IFRS, experience with further standards (e.g., Luxembourg, US) and audit experience are advantageous.
  • Reporting & Standards I Practical experience with Invest Europe Guidelines and strong command of reporting processes.
  • Tech & Tools I High IT affinity, experienced in fund-reporting software, advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills; interest in using project management software is a plus.
  • Working style & Personality I Analytical, detail-oriented, dynamic, deadline-driven and eager to learn continuously.
  • Languages I Very good English skills (written and spoken); proficiency in German is an advantage.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Impact & Modern Stack I Contribute to a scalable fund administration model with high-quality service. Visible impact across the entire value chain, not just “report assembly”.
  • Top Clients I First-class VC/PE client portfolios and a cooperation based on partnership.
  • Time for Quality I Realistic number of clients, templates, reviewer models, QA checklists. Risk-based sampling reviews and defined QA gates.
  • Training & Development I Develop into a subject matter expert based on your interest (valuation, IFRS, crypto, fund-of-funds etc.), support in obtaining certifications, tech-trainings.
  • Moore Global | Exciting and diverse field of activity with a broad spectrum of national and international clients and partner companies.
  • Corporate Benefits | Exclusive discounts with well-known partner companies.
  • Your Job Bike | Take advantage of our bike leasing program for greater mobility and a more sustainable commute.
  • Stay Healthy | Benefit from a private supplementary insurance policy we have arranged especially for you.

raw.description:
About the role

Alchemy is looking for a hands-on Director of Instructional Design to lead how our customers and our design team get the most out of Curie, Alchemy's AI-enabled course design software dedicated to reducing costs, accelerating course and program development, and driving educational outcomes. You will be the instructional design voice of the company: coaching customers as they roll Curie out to their faculty, setting the standards our designers work to, and making sure the ID work we sell is scoped, staffed, and delivered well.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a distributed team of instructional designers, including contractors, while still rolling up your sleeves on customer training, product testing, and proposal work. You will partner closely with the Director of Project Management and the VP of Product Development.

What you'll do

Customer enablement

  • Advise and train customers on implementing Curie with their faculty, including onboarding sessions, workshops, and faculty-facing guidance.
  • Speak credibly to instructional design principles and best practices with customers, faculty, and academic leaders.
  • Create and maintain training materials, job aids, and implementation guides for Curie.

Team leadership

  • Provide day-to-day direction to a distributed team of instructional designers, including employees and contractors, all working remotely.
  • Set scope for instructional design development on each project and assign work accordingly.
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard qualified instructional designers and contractors as project demand requires.
  • Give regular, constructive feedback and review work for quality and consistency.

Standards and quality

  • Establish and maintain instructional design standards for work built with Alchemy and Curie.
  • Ensure course designs meet accessibility and quality expectations, such as WCAG and Quality Matters.

Product partnership

  • Serve as the instructional design subject-matter expert for the Product Development team, weighing in on features and roadmap when asked.
  • Test and QA new Curie features and releases from an instructional designer's and faculty user's point of view.
  • Bring customer feedback and field insights back to the product team.

Scoping and delivery

  • Scope the instructional design portion of RFPs and proposals using the Alchemy product catalog.
  • Partner with the Director of Project Management to deliver projects within scope, budget, and timeline.
  • Work with the Director of Project Management to design repeatable, scalable approaches for large or multi-course projects.
  • Coordinate with outside vendors and partners when projects require it.
  • Lead projects as the instructional designer yourself when the situation warrants it.

What you bring

  • Master's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education, or a related field (bachelor's with equivalent experience considered).
  • 5+ years of instructional design experience in higher education, including online and hybrid course development.
  • 2+ years leading or directing instructional designers, including remote team members or contractors.
  • Strong command of instructional design models and learning science, such as ADDIE, backward design, and UDL.
  • Experience training or consulting with faculty and academic stakeholders.
  • Experience scoping ID work for proposals, statements of work, or project estimates.
  • Working knowledge of multiple LMSs, such as Canvas, Blackboard, D2L Brightspace, or Moodle.
  • Clear, confident communication and presentation skills with both technical and academic audiences.
  • Comfort testing software and giving structured, actionable feedback to product teams.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2) and accessibility testing.
  • Experience using AI tools as well as design and interactive creation tools such as the articulate suite, h5p, etc.

Nice to have

  • Experience in workforce development or corporate learning.
  • Experience managing vendor or partner relationships.
  • Experience at an EdTech company or in a client-facing services role.
  • Quality Matters certification or peer reviewer experience.

The details

  • Salary: 92,000–98,000, depending on experience
  • Location: Remote (US), with occasional travel to customer sites
  • Reports to: Chief Operating Officer
  • Benefits: As a full time employee of the Company you will be eligible to participate in a number of Company-sponsored benefits, including Unlimited PTO, Sick PTO and Holiday PTO plans. The Company offers Medical, Dental, and Vision insurances, as well as a 401k.
Salary: $92,000 – $98,000 / year
