Role Title: Child & Youth Abuse Trauma Specialist

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote

We are engaging mental health professionals to contribute their specialized knowledge to a high-impact customer project focused on supporting vulnerable youth. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideal for clinical experts deeply committed to working with young abuse survivors, especially those who have made this their primary clinical focus. You will play a key part in ensuring nuanced, accurate, and sensitive representation of mental health challenges faced by youth abuse victims.

Required Skills

  • trauma-informed care

  • clinical assessment

  • case analysis

  • ethical decision-making

  • content development

  • feedback and evaluation

  • youth abuse expertise

  • cross-disciplinary collaboration

  • privacy and confidentiality

  • iterative review processes

Scope of Work

  • Analyze and contribute to case-based scenarios reflecting the complexities of youth abuse victimization.

  • Review, assess, and provide feedback on model-generated mental health guidance related to abuse cases.

  • Develop and curate content outlining best practices for trauma-informed care for young abuse survivors.

  • Identify gaps or inaccuracies in AI-generated responses from a clinical and ethical perspective.

  • Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to ensure deliverables reflect current standards in mental health care for abuse victims.

  • Participate in iterative review cycles, offering insights to refine and improve training data quality.

  • Document recommendations to enhance system sensitivity, accuracy, and safety for vulnerable populations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MD, PhD (psychology), or PhD (social work) with completed credentials.

  • Extensive clinical experience working with youth who are victims of abuse, with a primary or exclusive focus in this area.

  • Demonstrated expertise in trauma-informed practices and interventions for young survivors.

  • Active clinical engagement in the field, dedicating the majority of working time to supporting abuse victims.

  • Commitment to upholding ethical standards and safeguarding participant privacy and well-being.

raw.excerpt: THE CHISHOLM LEGACY PROJECT SUMMARY:The mission of the Chisholm Legacy Project is rooted in the Just Transition Framework.
raw.description:
THE CHISHOLM LEGACY PROJECT SUMMARY:

The mission of the Chisholm Legacy Project is rooted in the Just Transition Framework. The project serves as a vehicle to connect Black communities on the frontlines of climate justice with resources to traverse the path from vision to strategy to action plan to implementation to transformation. In support of frontline leadership, the project seeks to link movements and mainstream entities with the tools necessary to advance systems change centered in equity and justice. With Black women on the frontlines of advancing systems change, this project ensures that these leaders have the support they need as they transform society from extractivism to a living economy that cares for sacred relationships between people and with Mother Earth, through regenerative, cooperative, democratic systems.

SUMMARY OF THEPOSITION:

The organization seeks a Senior Managing Director of Organizing with a commitment to supporting Black Liberation and a willingness to be on a learning journey, joining an institution that is grounded in Black Liberation, Climate Justice, and Just Transition. This position serves as a key member of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), providing strategic oversight and leadership to ensure alignment between programs, organizing, and strategy within The Chisholm Legacy Project (TCLP). The role is responsible for supervising senior programmatic leaders, fostering a culture centered on Black Liberation and Just Transition, and ensuring that TCLP’s work is mission-driven and community-centered.

Additionally, the Senior Managing Director of Organizing acts as a connector and facilitator, ensuring effective collaboration across departments, guiding organizing, and maintaining accountability for outcomes and impact. The SMDO also plays a critical role in assessing partnerships, representing TCLP in national spaces, and advancing key strategic initiatives to support just transition, including climate justice, gender justice, and Black liberation.

This position will be responsible for ensuring strategic alignment and consistent communication with the programs team in partnership with the Senior Managing Director of Programs.

Roles & Responsibilities

    Senior Leadership & Organizational Strategy

  • Serve on the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) contributing to mission, vision, strategy, and work plan development.
  • Collaborate with ELT to nurture an organizational culture centering Black Liberation and Just Transition.
  • Ensure organizational practices reflect connection, fulfillment, care, support, and purpose-driven accountability.
  • Provide co-leadership in fostering a culture that aligns with TCLP’s values.

    • Organizing Strategy, Infrastructure, and Movement Alignment

    • Provide executive leadership for the organization’s organizing function, ensuring that organizing strategy and structure advance TCLP’s broader mission, strategy, and movement-building goals.
    • Set the strategic direction for organizing approaches across regions, ensuring alignment with a community-centered theory of change and consistency in how outreach, engagement, and strategies are designed and deployed.
    • Ensure the development of a cohesive, organization-wide organizing framework that integrates tools and methodologies such as power mapping, narrative strategy, digital engagement, and community visioning.
    • Drive the evolution of innovative organizing strategies, and engagement models that strengthen grassroots leadership, deepen community relationships, and contribute to sustained environmental justice outcomes.
    • Cultivate and steward a robust ecosystem of partnerships across local, regional, and national stakeholders; including cross-movement, faith-based, and environmental justice organizations to expand collective impact and resource alignment for frontline communities.
    • Ensure alignment and integration between organizing and other core functions, including programs, communications, policy, research, and resource development, to support cohesive, constituency-driven strategies.
    • Provide strategic oversight of the structures, systems, and resource flows that enable effective organizing, ensuring alignment between priorities, investments, and long-term sustainability.

      • Team Leadership & Supervision

    • Provide supportive supervision to the Managing Director of Just Transition Municipalities Institute, Senior Director of Organizing and Senior Director of Narrative Strategy.
    • Ensure all direct reports and their teams have clear work plans and adhere to TCLP’s performance management system.
    • Maintain full accountability for departmental impact, balancing trust in team members with active verification.

      • Just Transition Municipal Strategy and Movement Integration

      • Provide executive oversight and strategic direction for TCLP’s Just Transition municipal strategy, ensuring alignment with TCLP’s broader organizing vision, and long-term goals.
      • Ensure the design and evolution of a scalable, multi-tiered engagement model that supports municipalities at varying levels of readiness, expanding access to Just Transition frameworks, tools, and pathways for implementation across diverse communities.
      • Steward the advancement of a national municipal ecosystem that enables local governments; particularly those serving historically disenfranchised communities; to adopt and implement community-driven Just Transition approaches.
      • Ensure the integration of leadership development and wellbeing-centered frameworks within municipal strategies, with a particular emphasis on advancing and sustaining Black femme leadership in local governance.
      • Drive the alignment of municipal organizing efforts with broader state, national, and global advocacy strategies, positioning Just Transition municipalities as a catalyst for systems-level policy change and widespread model adoption.
      • Ensure that municipal-based strategies are fully integrated into TCLP’s broader organizing infrastructure, including narrative strategy, policy development, research, and cross-movement coalition efforts, to maximize impact and coherence.

        • Focal Constituency Based Organizing Support

        • Global Afro Descendant Climate Justice Collaborative (GADCJC): Guide the development of cross-border and diaspora-based partnerships that connect U.S. communities with global communities, fostering shared learning, solidarity, and coordinated approaches to Just Transition and Black Liberation.
        • Black Base Building: Provide strategic leadership and oversight of TCLP’s engagement with Black-led base-building organizations across national, regional, and local movements, strengthening partnerships, collective capacity, and access to resources that advance Black Liberation and Just Transition. Ensure the team’s partnerships, and capacity-building efforts, including convenings, are aligned with organizational strategy and effectively connect movement organizations to TCLP’s programs, resources, and strategic opportunities.
        • Alignment Initiatives: Guide the strategic development of the Alignment Initiatives to advance inclusion, agency, and leadership for historically disenfranchised Black communities within the movements for climate justice and Black Liberation.

          • Narrative Strategy

        • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for narrative strategy work with frontline communities.
        • Provide strategic direction and management for leadership development and TCLP’s constituency communications efforts, including spokesperson development, media engagement, popular education and organizing partnerships, and amplification of frontline community voices.
        • Oversee the development and execution of key narrative initiatives and platforms, including the Black Climate Justice Toastmasters Initiative, Our Stories, Our Narratives Digital Media and Film Initiative, story library development, and narrative analysis to inform TCLP’s Just Transition communications strategy and messaging platform.

          • Partnerships & External Representation

        • Assess prospective partnerships with a focus on advancing Black Liberation and Just Transition.
        • Develop collaborative principles and terms of engagement for external partnerships.
        • Serve as a liaison for key national partnerships and represent TCLP in national working groups, boards, councils, strategy groups, and coalitions.

          • Additional Responsibilities

        • Take ownership of all programs, organizing, and strategy activities with a deep understanding of their implementation.
        • Perform other duties as needed to support TCLP’s vision, mission, and values.

          • Responsibilities as a People Manager

          Leadership, Development, and Team Engagement

        • Provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to support team growth and performance.
        • Foster an inclusive, positive workplace culture and implement strategies to improve employee engagement and satisfaction.
        • Conduct regular 1:1 meetings to understand team members' needs, set clear expectations, and provide constructive feedback.

          • Talent Management and Workforce Planning

        • Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and retention strategies to attract and keep top talent.
        • Align team goals and resources with organizational priorities, managing workloads and defining clear roles.

          • Performance, Compliance, and Problem-Solving

        • Conduct performance evaluations and address issues constructively.
        • Ensure compliance with company policies and legal requirements while resolving conflicts and concerns effectively.

          • Strategic Oversight and Change Management

        • Lead teams through organizational changes, ensuring smooth transitions and clear communication.
        • Utilize data-driven insights to inform decisions and report progress to senior leadership.

Qualifications

    The ideal candidate for this position will possess many, if not all, of the following qualifications and competencies:

  • Deep commitment to Black Liberation, Gender Justice, Climate Justice, and Just Transition;
  • 10+ years senior management experience at a social justice nonprofit organization of a similar size and complexity, with supervisory responsibilities including programmatic, finance, administrative, and operations;
  • Experience and appetite for guiding rapid and significant organizational growth, change and transformation, and investment in people and systems aligned with mission and values;
  • Proven ability to lead the development of collaborative, cross-functional teams and ability to support and inspire the leadership capacity of team members to innovate and achieve high impact,
  • Ability to ensure the team has a deep level of discernment in identifying high impact and strategic action, from the portfolio planning level to the day-to-day decision-making level.
  • Strong relationship builder, strengths-based leader, and communicator who values equity and justice, caring and compassion, collaboration, partnership, accountability, and learning;
  • Exemplary experience to provide supportive supervision, including identifying learning needs and matching with informational or technical resources, as well as conducting coaching where warranted;
  • A passion for and commitment to advocating for the creation of progressive policies and programs as well as for the elimination of policies and practices that lead to racial and ethnic disparities;
  • A successful track record in managing multiple projects simultaneously, setting priorities, and keen analytic, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills;
  • Proven ability to exercise strong judgment and make informed decisions while independently executing strategic initiatives with minimal supervision.
  • An ability to hold a long arc view of transformation while simultaneously holding an agenda consisting of short-term gains that affect change in current material conditions while building toward that long term change.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with an ability to prioritize, negotiate, and collaborate with a variety of internal and external stakeholders and manage difficult situations;
  • Exceptional writing skills.

Position Terms

  • This position is exempt and expected to work a 40-hour work week
  • This position will receive a 90-day (3 months) and 180-day (6 months) performance review that will take place following their first 90- and 180-days, respectively. This introductory review period is for the organization and the employee to assess mutual fit for the role.
  • Ability to travel upon request; in addition to traveling to in-person meetings for the organization including but not limited to 2 to 3 staff retreats a year.

Du bist Steuerfachangestellte/r und kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag? Dann setz dein Wissen dort ein, wo es gebraucht wird: ohne Abgabefristen, komplett im Homeoffice und auf Wunsch in Teilzeit.

Wir sind die Digitalagentur1 und begleiten Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei DATEV und der Digitalisierung. Unsere Kunden sind ausschließlich Steuerberater. Deren Mandanten betreust du nicht, und Belege buchst du auch nicht. Du schulst und berätst die Kanzleiteams, damit dort alles sauber läuft.

Warum ohne Fristendruck?

In der Kanzlei bestimmen Abgabetermine, Lohnläufe zum Monatsende und die Abschlusssaison deinen Kalender. Bei uns nicht: Du erstellst keine Steuererklärungen, keine Abschlüsse und keine Lohnabrechnungen. Deine Arbeit sind geplante Schulungen und Beratungstermine mit Kanzleien.

Pia war 7 Jahre in der Steuerkanzlei. Warum sie gewechselt hat:

Deine Aufgaben

  • Schulung: Du zeigst Kanzleiteams in Online-Schulungen, wie sie mit DATEV sicher und effizient arbeiten, vom ersten Klick bis zum festen Ablauf.

  • Beratung: Du begleitest Kanzleien bei Umstellungen, zum Beispiel auf digitale Belege, DATEV Unternehmen online, DATEV Arbeitnehmer online oder die digitale Personalakte.

  • Kanzlei-Organisation: Du schaust dir die Abläufe in der Kanzlei an und hilfst, sie zu verbessern.

  • Support: Du beantwortest DATEV-Rückfragen aus den Kanzleien, per Telefon, Videocall und Fernwartung direkt am Bildschirm.

  • Prozesse und Checklisten: Du entwickelst unsere Abläufe mit weiter, damit jeder Vorgang nach demselben klaren Standard läuft.

Unsere Themen

  • DATEV Rechnungswesen

  • DATEV Personalwirtschaft (LODAS und Lohn und Gehalt)

  • Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation

  • DATEV Cloud, zum Beispiel DATEV Unternehmen online oder DATEV Personal

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • Kein Fristendruck: Keine Abgabetermine, keine Abschlusssaison, kein Stress beim Lohn zum Monatsende.

  • 100 % Homeoffice, deutschlandweit: Kein Umzug, kein Pendeln, keine Reisetätigkeit. Schulungen und Beratung laufen online.

  • Teilzeit möglich: Ab 22 Stunden pro Woche, Vollzeit sind 40 Stunden.

  • Planbare Arbeitszeiten: Feste Kernzeiten Montag bis Donnerstag ab 8:30 Uhr, mindestens 5,5 Stunden am Tag. Das lässt sich gut mit Familie und Alltag verbinden.

  • Klare Abläufe: Feste Prozesse und Checklisten statt Improvisation. Du weißt jeden Tag, woran du bist.

  • Ein Team hinter dir: Auch im Homeoffice bist du nicht allein. Bei Fragen hilft dir das Team jederzeit weiter.

Was wir bieten

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen.

  • Vollständige Einarbeitung: Wir gehen alle Themen gemeinsam durch, üben sie mit dir und lassen dich erst eigenständig arbeiten, wenn du dich sicher fühlst.

  • Laufende Weiterbildung, damit du fachlich immer auf dem aktuellen Stand bist.

  • Gute Vergütung: Dazu Weihnachtsgeld und vermögenswirksame Leistungen.

  • Kollegiale Atmosphäre: Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und unterstützen uns gegenseitig.

„Nur noch die schönen Seiten vom Beruf“: Eine Kollegin erzählt von Bewerbung, Einarbeitung und Alltag:

Zwei wichtige Hinweise

Die Tätigkeit ist ausschließlich aus Deutschland oder dem europäischen Ausland möglich. Und weil bei uns alles online läuft, brauchst du zu Hause eine stabile Internetleitung.

Die Bewerbung dauert nur wenige Minuten. Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht.

Mehr über uns findest du auf und auf unserem YouTube-Kanal: .

Das bringst du mit

  • Praxis mit DATEV Rechnungswesen oder DATEV Personalwirtschaft (LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt). Eines von beiden reicht, den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

  • Du erklärst gerne und hast Geduld, auch wenn dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal kommt.

  • Du kommunizierst freundlich und klar, am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich.

  • Du arbeitest im Homeoffice selbstständig und zuverlässig.

Du möchtest dein Wissen aus der Kanzlei weitergeben, mit planbaren Arbeitszeiten und ohne Fristendruck? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)

Schedule: Flexible, you pick the hours and days (including weekends if desired)

Required Skills

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

As an expert you will be creating Reinforcement Learning Environments which test an AI model’s ability to solve complex software engineering problems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. Tasks may involve fixing bugs, implementing features, refactoring code, or optimizing performance while requiring agents to discover and reason over information from real MCP servers. raw.title: AI Engineer (Computer Vision and Applied GenAI)
raw.excerpt: Location: Amman, Jordan.  Fully remote.  Type: Full-time, permanent.
raw.description:
Location: Amman, Jordan. Fully remote.

Type: Full-time, permanent.

Level: Mid-level, roughly 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience.

Languages: English required. German is a strong plus.

About the role

We are looking for an AI Engineer based in Amman who will work remotely with a distributed engineering team. This is a builder role, not a research role. You will take AI capabilities from prototype to something that runs reliably in production, and you will own your work end to end: the model, the data around it, the service that serves it, and the evidence that it actually works.

The work spans two areas. On one side, computer vision and perception: camera pipelines, object detection and recognition, and inference that has to run fast and stay stable. On the other, applied generative AI: LLM-based features, retrieval, agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them honest. You will not be handed a narrow slice of either. You will be expected to move between them and to build the plumbing that connects them to a real product.

Tasks

  • Design, train, fine-tune and evaluate models for vision tasks (detection, classification, segmentation, tracking) and integrate them into production pipelines.
  • Build LLM-powered features: retrieval-augmented generation, tool-using agents, structured extraction, and the prompt and evaluation infrastructure behind them.
  • Write the services around the models: APIs, data pipelines, batch and streaming jobs, storage.
  • Optimise for the target hardware, including quantisation, batching, and inference on edge devices where cloud inference is not an option.
  • Define and track quality metrics. Establish a baseline before claiming an improvement, and be able to show where a number came from.
  • Instrument, monitor and debug models in production: drift, latency, failure modes, and the unglamorous work of finding out why a pipeline broke at 3am.
  • Work directly with product and business stakeholders to turn a vague need into a scoped, measurable deliverable.
  • Document what you build so that the next engineer does not have to reverse-engineer it.

Requirements

  • 3 to 5 years building and shipping machine learning or AI systems in production. Personal projects and Kaggle notebooks alone will not cover this.
  • Strong Python. Clean, tested, reviewable code, not notebook-only output.
  • Practical depth in at least one of the two areas below, and working familiarity with the other:
  • Computer vision: PyTorch or TensorFlow, OpenCV, modern detection and segmentation architectures, dataset creation and annotation workflows.
  • Applied GenAI: LLM APIs and open-weight models, RAG, embeddings and vector stores, agent frameworks, prompt design, and systematic evaluation.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, code review, testing, CI, Docker, and comfort on the Linux command line.
  • Experience deploying a model as a service and keeping it running, including cloud deployment (AWS, Azure or GCP) and basic observability.
  • SQL and general data handling: you can find, clean and reason about the data before modelling it.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, and the self-direction that remote work requires. You are comfortable writing things down, flagging blockers early, and working without someone checking in on you hourly.

Strong plus

  • German language skills. Part of the team and a meaningful share of the documentation, meetings and stakeholder communication are in German. Any level from solid B1 upward is a real advantage, and it will widen the scope of what you can own. It is not a hard requirement, and we will support you in improving it.
  • Edge and embedded inference: NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO.
  • Video streaming and industrial camera work: RTSP, GStreamer, GenICam, machine vision cameras.
  • MLOps tooling: MLflow, Weights and Biases, DVC, Kubernetes, model registries.
  • Experience in an industrial, robotics, IoT or B2B product environment.
  • A public track record: open source contributions, technical writing, or published work.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the Amman market for this level.
  • Fully remote setup.
  • Real ownership of features that reach customers, rather than proof-of-concept work that is quietly shelved.
  • Direct exposure to the European market and to senior technical decision making.

How we work

  • Remote-first, with asynchronous written communication as the default and a reasonable overlap window with the European working day.
  • Small teams, short decision paths, and direct access to the people who set priorities.
  • We prefer a working pilot with a clear owner and a measurable outcome over a long specification.
  • Human oversight, data protection and security are part of the definition of done, not an afterthought bolted on before launch.

raw.title: Reputation & AI Visibility Specialist
raw.excerpt: About Eleanor Health At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives.
raw.description:
About Eleanor Health

At Eleanor Health we are helping people affected by addiction live amazing lives. We work to fulfill this goal by building and growing the first addiction and mental health services provider designed to deliver a longitudinal, whole-person, value-based model of care for each community member. Our team is ambitious and committed to this unique opportunity, and understands the importance of attracting strong and experienced talent to make our vision for Eleanor Health a reality every day, and for every recovery journey we are entrusted to be a part of.

About the Role

When someone searches for a suboxone doctor near them, asks an AI assistant where to get help with drinking, or reads a community thread about virtual addiction treatment, we want Eleanor Health to show up — accurately, warmly, and in a way that helps them take the next step.

Today, these responsibilities are distributed across several people without dedicated operational ownership. You would become the hands-on owner responsible for turning that strategy into consistent execution.

As the Reputation & AI Visibility Specialist, you will own how Eleanor Health appears across the places people actually look for treatment: business listings and healthcare directories in every market we serve, reviews, recovery communities, earned media, and the AI assistants and AI-generated search results that an increasing share of people now ask first.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of local search, reputation management, community engagement, and the emerging discipline of getting recommended by AI. It is not a brand awareness position with soft metrics — it is an acquisition role with a number attached, and it carries a capability our growth plan depends on.

We will also be honest with you about what you would be walking into. Today we manage our directory presence off the side of several desks, and we do it poorly. Reviews are unmanaged. Nobody is watching what community members say about us. You would inherit a real mess and a real opportunity, in roughly equal measure.

This role reports to the Sr. Manager, Organic & AI Visibility.

What You'll Do

Local Presence & Directory Integrity

  • Own Eleanor Health's business listings across every market we serve, including Google Business Profile, Apple Business Connect, and Bing Places
  • Manage healthcare directory and health plan provider directory listings, and the data aggregators that feed them
  • Audit and remediate name, address, and phone consistency across all platforms and markets
  • Establish and maintain category strategy, service listings, hours, attributes, and profile completeness
  • Build and maintain a system of record for listings so accuracy does not depend on any one person's memory
  • Identify and resolve listing suppressions, duplicates, and unverified profiles
  • Partner with content and web owners to ensure location data, service information, and other entity information remain consistent between EleanorHealth.com and external listings/directories

Reviews & Reputation Management

  • Design and operate an ethical review generation program in partnership with clinical and access teams, with patient privacy protected absolutely and no incentivization or gating
  • Respond to reviews across platforms with warmth, care, and without defensiveness
  • Monitor review volume, rating, and sentiment by market and surface patterns to clinical and operations leadership
  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to ensure all review practices meet HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 requirements
  • Maintain an escalation process for reviews or reputation issues requiring clinical, compliance, legal, or operational response

AI Visibility & Discoverability

  • Establish a baseline for how often and how accurately AI assistants and AI-generated search results recommend Eleanor Health, then improve it
  • Monitor for material misinformation about Eleanor Health, and about addiction treatment generally, in AI-generated responses
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen Eleanor Health's entity signals, citations, authoritative third-party mentions, and other external signals that influence AI discoverability and recommendation
  • Partner with the content, web, and technical SEO functions to translate AI visibility findings into prioritized website improvements, including structured content, metadata, internal linking, location content, structured data, and other discoverability enhancements
  • Track and report AI citation and recommendation share on a regular cadence
  • Stay current in a discipline that is being invented in real time, and help invent it here
  • Implement approved discoverability updates in Sanity and other marketing platforms where appropriate

Community Engagement

  • Monitor how Eleanor Health and virtual addiction treatment are discussed in recovery communities, forums, and social platforms
  • Participate transparently and helpfully as an identified representative of Eleanor Health, never anonymously
  • Surface community sentiment, recurring concerns, and misinformation to marketing and clinical leadership
  • Support and manage organic social activity where it directly advances discoverability, community engagement, or reputation goals

Earned Media & Editorial Distribution

  • Manage the day-to-day public relations agency relationship in alignment with established priorities, including setting priorities, triaging inbound opportunities, and holding the agency accountable to outcomes
  • Brief Eleanor Health spokespeople ahead of media opportunities
  • Own hands-on editorial distribution and syndication efforts to strengthen Eleanor Health’s authority, earn relevant backlinks and citations, and grow referring domains in priority markets
  • Evaluate earned media and distribution opportunities based on their potential contribution to authority, discoverability, reputation, and enrollment impact

Measurement & Reporting

  • Build and maintain your own reporting on listings accuracy, review performance, AI citation share, and earned coverage
  • Partner with our analytics consultant to attribute non-paid new member volume accurately
  • Report performance on a monthly cadence and be able to defend an attribution claim

You'll Be a Good Fit If You:

  • Are a genuine hands-on operator who does the work rather than directing it — multi-market listing management is tedious and unglamorous, and you have to find that acceptable
  • Find the constraints of a regulated healthcare environment energizing rather than frustrating, and raise your hand before crossing a line rather than after
  • Write well, and understand that tone matters enormously when the audience is someone on the hardest day of their life
  • Are self-directed and able to identify and resolve gaps without being prompted
  • Are comfortable being measured, and would rather own a number than a set of activities
  • Approach your work with compassion, knowing that a correct directory listing is sometimes the difference between someone finding care and giving up

Skills and Competencies:

  • Experience — roughly 3+ years in digital marketing with real depth in local SEO, reputation management, or digital PR, including hands-on multi-location listing management
  • Reputation management — experience building or running a review generation and response program
  • Tooling — fluency with SEO and local tooling. Our stack includes Ahrefs, BrightLocal, Local Falcon, Otterly.ai, and Screaming Frog. You should be comfortable in tools like these and able to tell us which ones we are using wrong
  • Writing — strong written communication across review responses, community posts, and media briefs
  • Analytical — comfort building your own reporting and defending your numbers
  • Judgment — sound decision-making in a space with hard compliance constraints around patient privacy
  • Adaptability — comfortable learning new systems and working in a discipline that is still taking shape

Helpful but not required:

  • Behavioral health, addiction treatment, or healthcare marketing experience
  • Early hands-on work in generative engine optimization or AI search visibility
  • Working knowledge of structured data and schema markup
  • Real, disclosed participation in online communities
  • Multi-market or multi-location experience at any scale

What This Role Is Not:

We would rather be clear now than waste your time.

  • Not primarily a media relations seat. We retain a PR agency for pitching and placement; you would direct them. If hands-on media relations is the work you love most, you would find this role only partly satisfying.
  • Not a paid media role. Paid search and paid media sit elsewhere on the team.
  • Not a content writing role. We have a content strategist and a copywriter. You will write a great deal, but not long-form content.
  • Not a growth-hacking role. No incentivized or gated reviews, no undisclosed community participation, and no shortcuts that trade a person's trust for a metric. We will turn down tactics that work if they are not honest, and we would want you to be the person raising your hand first.

Compensation & Benefits

The total target compensation range for this position is $70,000-80,000. The actual compensation offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job.

Eleanor Health offers a generous benefits package to full-time employees, which includes:

  • Generous Paid Time Off (prorated for new employees) - unplug, relax, and recharge!
    • 12 Vacation days
    • 12 Wellness (Sick) days
    • 3 Floating holidays
    • 9 Company-observed holidays
    • Jury Duty, Voting Leave, and other forms of paid time off may be available
  • Eleanor-paid medical and dental insurance plans, with affordable vision coverage -We are a health first company, and we strive to make our plans affordable and accessible.
  • 401(k) plan with 3% match - We are excited to be able to support the long-term financial well-being of our team in a way that reinforces Eleanor’s commitment to equity.
  • Short-term disability - We understand that things happen, we want you to feel comfortable to take time to get better.
  • Long Term Disability - Picks up where Short Term Disability leaves off (employee paid).
  • Life Insurance - Both Eleanor and employee-paid options are available.
  • Family Medical Leave -Eleanor Health’s Paid Family & Medical Leave (“PFML”) is designed to provide flexibility and financial peace of mind for approved family and medical reasons such as the birth, adoption, or fostering of a child, and for serious health conditions that you or a family member/significant other might be facing.
  • Wellness Perks & Benefits -Mental Health is important to us and we want our employees to have the accessibility you deserve to talk things through, zen with a mindfulness app, or seek assistance from health advocates
    • Mindfulness App Reimbursement
    • EAP with eight face-to-face sessions
    • Virtual health and wellness visits covered by our medical plan.

Department:

Technology

Our Company Promise

We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description:

Summer 2027 Cybersecurity Engineering Internships


Please print/save the job description because it won’t be available after you apply. 


To be considered, please ensure that you attach a resume to your application. 


We ask that you apply with your personal email address rather than your school email (.edu) so we can stay connected about future roles at Southwest.


Southwest Airlines is committed to providing Employees with equal opportunities for learning and personal growth. As a Technology Intern, you’ll contribute to real-time projects, collaborate with fellow interns and cross-functional teams, help advance Company initiatives, and support Southwest’s Purpose of connecting People to what’s important in their lives through friendly, reliable, and low-cost air travel. Throughout the internship, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop as a future professional while making a meaningful impact. The Cybersecurity Engineering Intern should be a strong communicator and collaborator, capable of presenting ideas in both technical and user-friendly terms while helping shape the future of Southwest’s Technology Team.If hired, Interns may be selected to support one of the following Teams:

Identity and Access Management

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Team develops and supports the solutions that manage digital identities and secure access to applications, systems, and data across Southwest. As a Cybersecurity Engineer Intern, you will gain hands-on experience supporting modern identity governance and administration initiatives while working with enterprise identity platforms, automation, and access management technologies. You'll collaborate with Cybersecurity Engineers and Technology Teams to help improve identity lifecycle management, streamline legacy processes, and enhance security through automation and AI-driven capabilities. This internship provides valuable exposure to identity and access management practices and demonstrates how secure, efficient access enables and protects enterprise technology operations.

Cloud Cyber Security

The Cloud Cyber Security Team engineers and secures the cloud platforms and services that support Southwest's technology ecosystem. As a Cybersecurity Engineer Intern, you will gain hands-on experience helping design, implement, and support cloud security solutions that enable secure and scalable technology delivery. You'll collaborate with Cybersecurity Engineers and Technology Teams while gaining exposure to cloud security controls, infrastructure security, automation, secure development practices, threat detection, and security monitoring. This internship provides valuable exposure to modern cloud security engineering and demonstrates how technology enables the secure delivery of critical business and operational capabilities across Southwest.


Additional Details

  • Receive free, unlimited space available travel privileges for yourself (taxes and fees may apply on international travel).
  • Interns will be provided any required equipment, such as a laptop, for the internship.

We’re looking for a copywriter who’s excited to carry that voice into our always-on channels: the touchpoints that reach millions of people to inspire them to understand their bodies and have agency over their health.

You’ll work closely with our marketing, growth, and design teams to turn briefs into copy that’s unmistakably Clue, and leans into our brand pillars: body literacy, agency and health equity.

raw.title: Lead Instructional Designer (Contract)
raw.excerpt: ABOUT THE WORKThe Lead ID is accountable for the quality of what leaves Alchemy on a project.
raw.description:
ABOUT THE WORK

The Lead ID is accountable for the quality of what leaves Alchemy on a project. You would oversee a small group of instructional designers across a set of concurrent courses, reviewing their work before it reaches the client and acting as the design authority when questions come up.

This is a contract role scoped per project rather than per course, and it runs alongside the client's development calendar.

It is a client-facing role. You are the person a client escalates a design question to, and the person who explains a design decision when it needs explaining. You will also be coaching contract designers who are often new to the client and sometimes joining a course that is already half built.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Quality and design authority

Review each course plan, course guide batch and LMS build against the client's standards and our checklists before it is submitted, and sign off before it goes to the client.

Give design feedback to the designers on your project. Not line edits, but the substantive calls: whether an outcome is assessable, whether an assessment measures what it claims to, whether the activity mix earns its place.

Confirm each course team has completed the review checklist before submission, and return work that is not ready rather than passing it through.

Act as the bridge to the build. Review the built course against the approved blueprint, check interactives render and behave once packaged into the LMS, and make the design calls when a build question needs one.

Hold the line on accessibility and the client's design standards across every course on the project.

Meetings and client contact

Attend client calls for your project. You are the design voice in those rooms: present decisions, explain trade-offs, and absorb feedback without conceding standards we should not concede. This is a core part of the role and is included in the engagement fee.

Attend ID and SME calls as necessary, or as the project requires. That is usually where an SME is new to online design, a subject is unusually complex, or a course is in trouble.

Attend additional project calls as necessary, or as your contract stipulates.

Team and project

Coach designers who are new to the project or to the client's standards, including designers who have joined mid-development and are inheriting someone else's partial work.

Onboard new contract designers to the client's templates, review process and standards.

Work with the project manager on sequencing, risk and realistic dates, and raise scope or capacity problems early rather than absorbing them.

Keep your review status visible in the project system so the PM can see what is waiting on you.

HOW THE ENGAGEMENT WORKS

Contracted per project under a work for hire agreement, with a defined scope of courses and a defined period of performance.

Paid at defined milestones against that scope. Not hourly, no timesheet.

Expect a recurring weekly commitment rather than a burst of effort. Review work arrives on the development calendar, and the calendar does not wait.

The course list can change. Courses get added, removed, delayed or reassigned. Material changes to the scope are handled as a contract amendment.

You will work in our systems and the client's: Google Workspace, Slack, the project system, and the client's LMS.

We use AI tooling in our process, including our own platform, and part of this role is judging where AI generated content meets our standards and where it does not.

We expect a reply to email and Slack within one business day, and review turnaround inside the window stated in your contract. A late review blocks a build, which blocks a client date.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Several years designing courses, including courses you took end to end yourself. You cannot review what you have not done.

Experience reviewing other designers' work and giving direct, actionable feedback without damaging the relationship.

Confident judgement on outcome alignment, assessment design and scope, and the willingness to say that something is not ready.

Experience with learning management systems, Canvas and Brightspace in particular, and with how design decisions survive or fail at the build stage.

Comfort in client-facing meetings, including ones where you are delivering news the client does not want.

The ability to hold several courses in your head at once and know which one is about to slip.

A degree in education, instructional design, instructional technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience leading contract or freelance designers rather than employees.

Experience onboarding designers into a project that is already running.

Experience with Articulate Storyline, Rise or H5P, enough to judge whether an interactive design is buildable.

Quality Matters certification or similar.

We’re currently seeking a Data Analyst to support system implementation and data conversion projects for our operator clients.

This role is responsible for executing structured data conversion, validation, and cleansing tasks within an approved solution design. The Data Analyst supports implementation efforts by preparing, transforming, and validating legacy data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and readiness for system conversion.

TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.

Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.

Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.

Sales Executive, Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes (SC ABP)

Position Summary

The Sales Executive, Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes (SC ABP) is responsible for creating, developing, and growing TraceLink's Supply Chain Agentic Business Process business within a defined portfolio of strategic customer and prospect accounts. Serving as the primary commercial owner for the Supply Chain ABP commercialization journey, the Sales Executive partners with executive business and technology leaders to transform end-to-end supply chain business processes into Agentic Business Processes.

Many customers will simultaneously participate in the Track & Trace ABP commercialization journey. In these situations, the Sales Executive works collaboratively with Track & Trace Customer Account Manager (CAM) to deliver a seamless "one account" customer experience while independently owning the Supply Chain ABP commercial relationship.

This role is ideal for an executive-level consultative seller who excels at business transformation, executive relationship development, strategic solution selling, and creating new enterprise software businesses.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Supply Chain ABP Commercial Journey

  • Serve as the primary commercial owner for the Supply Chain ABP commercialization journey across an assigned portfolio of strategic accounts.

  • Develop executive account strategies that establish and grow the Supply Chain ABP business.

  • Build trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior business and IT leaders.

  • Position TraceLink's vision for the Agentic Supply Chain Operating Model, Agentic Supply Chain Operating System, Agentic Business Processes, and OPUS Agents.

  • Lead executive discovery, strategic account planning, and long-term transformation roadmaps.

  • Coordinate executive alignment sessions, business process discovery workshops, and Agentic Business Process strategy engagements.

Create New Supply Chain Transformation Businesses

  • Identify, qualify, and develop new Supply Chain ABP opportunities within existing and prospective customers.

  • Lead customers through the Agentic Business Process commercialization journey, including the Agentic Accelerator Program (AAP), thereby establishing an executive-aligned mutual action plan that is co-executed with the champion

  • Effectively position TraceLink's Supply Chain ABP portfolio, OPUS Platform, OPUS Agents, Agentic Control Tower, and Agentic Business Network as the foundation for enterprise supply chain transformation.

  • Work collaboratively with the Business Process Architects and Value Engineering teams to build compelling executive business cases demonstrating measurable operational and financial outcomes.

  • Develop expansion strategies that establish long-term strategic partnerships across multiple business processes and functions

Drive Commercial Excellence

  • Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies using TraceLink's WISE agentic operating platform's insights and analysis.

  • Lead opportunities through TraceLink's commercial sales process while applying disciplined MEDDPICC qualification.

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline capable of consistently achieving assigned bookings objectives.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, opportunity strategies, executive engagement plans, and account documentation within WISE and CRM.

  • Ensure disciplined pipeline hygiene, opportunity progression, forecast accuracy, and commercial governance.

  • Utilize TraceLink's business value frameworks, commercial methodologies, and executive messaging to execute consistent customer engagements.

Lead Cross-Functional Solutioning

  • Coordinate ABP Architects, Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, Channels & Alliances, and executive leadership throughout the sales cycle.

  • Lead internal account strategy sessions and opportunity reviews to maximize win probability.

  • Ensure customers experience coordinated commercial engagement across all TraceLink teams.

Partner Across Commercial Businesses

  • Collaborate closely with Track & Trace Customer Account Managers to promote a unified "One Account" customer experience.

  • Leverage insights from the Track & Trace business to identify Supply Chain ABP opportunities.

  • Share customer intelligence that creates reciprocal growth opportunities across both commercialization journeys.

  • Coordinate executive engagement strategies that maximize long-term customer value while maintaining clear commercial ownership across each business.

Success Measures

The Sales Executive is measured on:

  • Supply Chain ABP Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR)

  • New Customer Acquisition

  • Existing Customer Expansion ARR (MINT, POET, OPUS Agents)

  • Supply Chain ABP Pipeline Coverage

  • Forecast Accuracy

  • MEDDPICC Qualification Quality

  • Pipeline Hygiene and Commercial Process Compliance

  • Successful Completion of Agentic Accelerator Programs

  • Executive Engagement (CxO Meetings, Discovery Workshops, Blueprint Reviews, Proof-of-Value Reviews)

  • Adoption of WISE

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 6+ years of enterprise software or technology sales experience.

  • Demonstrated success selling complex enterprise transformation initiatives to executive stakeholders.

  • Proven success creating new enterprise software businesses and consistently achieving bookings objectives.

  • Experience leading multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and strategic account planning skills.

  • Experience with structured enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC.

  • Travel up to 20-30%

Advantageous Experience

  • Life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or supply chain software experience.

  • Experience selling supply chain planning, execution, ERP, AI, automation, or digital transformation solutions.

  • Knowledge of business process transformation, operational excellence, and enterprise AI.

  • Experience working within matrixed global organizations.

Core Competencies

  • Executive Relationship Development

  • Enterprise Solution Selling

  • Business Transformation

  • Strategic Account Planning

  • Business Value Selling

  • Commercial Negotiation

  • MEDDPICC Opportunity Qualification

  • Pipeline & Forecast Management

  • Cross-Functional Leadership

What Success Looks Like

Successful Sales Executives create entirely new Supply Chain Agentic Business Process businesses within strategic accounts by helping customers reimagine how supply chain work is performed. They establish trusted executive relationships, build compelling transformation visions, execute disciplined commercial processes, and consistently deliver predictable bookings growth. By collaborating seamlessly with Track & Trace Customer Account Managers and Business Process Architects, they create long-term strategic partnerships that accelerate customer transformation while reinforcing TraceLink's "One Account" commercial strategy and long-term Agentic Business Process vision.

raw.description:
Authority développe une plateforme d’intelligence sectorielle qui associe expertise humaine et données afin d’améliorer les articles en ligne et les prévisions portant sur des résultats économiques, financiers et commerciaux.

Nous recherchons un Conseiller en trésorerie d’entreprise actuellement actif sur le marché français et disposant d’informations de marché à jour. Il s’agit d’une mission de conseil rémunérée et flexible, jusqu’à 2 heures par mois.

Vos missions

  • Fournir des commentaires écrits ou enregistrés, concis, sur les évolutions récentes, les changements de marché et leurs conséquences probables.
  • Vérifier l’exactitude d’articles, de rapports et d’hypothèses de prévision, notamment concernant le fonds de roulement, la dette et la structure du capital, la couverture des risques, les technologies de trésorerie, les contrôles et la gouvernance.
  • Expliquer les implications pratiques pour les entreprises, les investisseurs et les décideurs.
  • Contribuer à des contenus susceptibles d’être publiés par Authority et dans de grands médias professionnels.
  • Selon les besoins, envisager des missions distinctes de conseil de marché auprès d’organisations de notre clientèle.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience professionnelle pertinente.
  • Activité actuelle sur le marché français et connaissance récente de ses évolutions.
  • Expérience directe de décisions financières, commerciales ou d’investissement importantes dans ce domaine.
  • Capacité à expliquer clairement et brièvement des sujets complexes.
  • Profil LinkedIn valide présentant une expérience pertinente.

Modalités

  • Contrat de conseil indépendant.
  • Mission à distance depuis la France.
  • Jusqu’à 2 heures de conseil rémunérées par mois.
  • Missions flexibles, principalement des commentaires courts et des appels occasionnels.
  • Des missions de conseil supplémentaires pourront être proposées séparément selon le profil et la demande des clients.

À propos d’Authority

Authority développe de l’intelligence sectorielle, des prévisions et des contenus fondés sur l’expertise afin d’aider les organisations à prendre de meilleures décisions stratégiques.

raw.title: Business Development Executive
raw.excerpt: About Tort Experts At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector.
raw.description:
About Tort Experts

At Tort Experts, we are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that can truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting-edge technology, data-driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve. If you’re looking for a workplace where your contributions can truly make a difference, and where innovation meets purpose, Tort Experts is the perfect place for you.

About the role

This is a true outbound, new business role focused on closing high-value deals with litigation funders, plaintiff law firms, and institutional buyers. You will build your pipeline from scratch, lead complex consultative sales conversations, and close six- and seven-figure engagements. This is not an account management or inbound role. We are looking for a proven hunter who consistently exceeds quota.

You will operate inside a structured sales system with defined process, pipeline discipline, and weekly accountability. The infrastructure and playbook are purpose-built to set you up for success from day one.

What you'll do

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close for new client acquisition. Your primary objective is net-new revenue.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, conference networking, referral development, and warm introductions. This is an outbound-driven role.
  • Lead high-level discovery conversations with managing directors at litigation funds, managing partners at plaintiff firms, and investment directors at PE-backed case acquisition vehicles.
  • Navigate and structure complex, consultative sales conversations where deal structures vary by client type, lawsuit category, and capital deployment model.
  • Develop and execute a territory plan for your assigned market segment. Segments may include PE and institutional litigation funds, active plaintiff firms, or hybrid fund and firm structures.
  • Maintain rigorous pipeline management and forecasting discipline in the CRM, ensuring accuracy and visibility into deal progression.
  • Attend industry conferences (including MTMP and similar mass tort events) as a primary channel for relationship development and deal origination.
  • Partner with Client Success to ensure seamless post-close handoffs, protecting client relationships and supporting long-term revenue retention.
  • Provide market intelligence and competitive feedback to inform positioning, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Leverage AI-first tools and workflows to maximize prospecting efficiency, research, and outreach quality.

Required

  • 3 to 7 years of full-cycle B2B sales experience with a track record of consistently exceeding quota. You have closed deals, not just sourced them.
  • Proven hunter mentality. You have built pipeline from scratch through outbound effort, not inherited accounts or relied on inbound leads.
  • Experience selling high-value services or solutions with deal sizes of $500K or more in annual contract value. You are comfortable in six- and seven-figure deal conversations.
  • Relationship-driven sales approach. You know how to build trust with senior decision-makers, including attorneys, fund managers, and C-suite executives. You are strategic, not transactional.
  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills. You ask the right questions, understand client needs deeply, and position solutions around outcomes, not features.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and early-stage environments. You are joining a team that is being built, not one that is already running. Process is being established and you will help shape it.
  • Disciplined pipeline management. You maintain accurate forecasts, update your CRM religiously, and can speak to your pipeline with precision at any moment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically for conferences, client meetings, and industry events. Travel is a meaningful part of this role.
  • Proficiency with AI tools for research, outreach, and workflow optimization. An AI-first mindset is a requirement, not a preference.
  • US-based with authorization to work in the United States.

Preferred

  • Direct experience in mass tort, litigation finance, legal services, or legal marketing. You understand the ecosystem, the players, and how capital flows into case acquisition.
  • Existing relationships within the plaintiff bar, litigation funding community, or mass tort conference circuit.
  • Experience selling into law firms, PE-backed funds, or financial services buyers where deal cycles involve relationship-building, trust, and multi-stakeholder navigation.
  • Background in performance marketing, lead generation, or case acquisition services sold to legal buyers.
  • Familiarity with the conference-driven sales motion common in mass tort, including MTMP, AAJ, and similar events.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • Complete onboarding and develop working fluency in Tort Experts’ service model, pricing structure, active lawsuit categories, and competitive positioning.
  • Build your initial target list and begin outbound prospecting in your assigned segment.
  • Attend at least one industry conference and establish initial relationships with prospective clients.
  • Have active discovery conversations in your pipeline with qualified prospects.

Months 4 Through 12

  • Close your first new client engagements and begin building a book of recurring revenue.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline with sufficient coverage to support consistent monthly closes.
  • Establish a repeatable rhythm of outbound activity, conference follow-up, and relationship development that generates predictable deal flow.
  • Contribute market feedback and prospect intelligence that sharpens the team’s go-to-market approach.

Compensation

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience.
  • Performance-based commission structure tied to new client revenue, with meaningful upside for top performers.
  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

  • 100% company-paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500 level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US based employees):
    • medical (Aetna)
    • dental (Guardian)
    • vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution
  • 401k plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US based employees)
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage
  • Wellhub wellness benefit — access to 20,000+ gyms, studios, and wellness apps, fully covered by the company
  • Work from home equipment budget (at company's discretion)
  • Forever remote work environment

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and are driven, client-focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top-tier legal representation. Are you ready to lead the next wave of growth in legal marketing? Apply today and help us transform access to justice!

Please note that you may receive emails on behalf of Tort Experts from . This is not spam and has been sent from our HR/Payroll system, Rippling.

If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you directly. We kindly ask that you do not reach out to inquire about the status of your application. Due to the volume of submissions, we are unable to respond to individual application status requests.

AA/EEO Statement:

Tort Experts provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

raw.description:
The Revenue Cycle Management Insurance Verification (RCM IV) Specialist is responsible for utilizing the daily insurance verification report to complete insurance coverage and benefits. This role is critical to the success of each patient's visit, as the IV specialist ensures that the patient's insurance, coverage table, fee schedule, and other relevant details are accurately linked prior to the scheduled appointment. The IV specialist will also respond to same-day appointment requests. A comprehensive understanding of various insurance plans and benefits is essential for the insurance verification specialists.

This role requires exceptional accuracy and efficiency, along with a readiness to perform effectively in demanding situations.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Procure a comprehensive breakdown of benefits for each patient utilizing ZKeep or through direct phone contact if not previously acquired via the automated bot. Upload this documentation to the patient's document center.
  • Responsibility for accurately associating patients with their respective insurance plans, fee schedules, creating new group plans as required, updating coverage tables, maximums, frequency limitations and deductibles within Dentrix Enterprise.
  • Process all work that is assigned through the insurance verification hub and the goal is to complete no less than 75 verifications per day.
  • Prompt resolution with all tickets assigned being completed within a 20 minute period. For those ‘in chair’ completion of the request to be completed within a 10 minute timeframe.
  • 95% of all appointments verified with no errors.
  • Liaise with dental offices as necessary regarding patient coverage and/or benefits.
  • Maintain and update the master fee grid by integrating new plan information as it becomes available.

Requirements and Skills:

  • A minimum of one to two years of experience in the dental field is required.
  • Proficiency in computer applications, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and the Google Suite.
  • Experience with practice management software is required, with a preference for Dentrix.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Proven capability to manage and prioritize multiple concurrent tasks.
Position Details:
  • Schedule - Full Time - must be able to work evenings and one Saturday per month
  • Compensation - $20.00-$22.00/hour
  • This is a fully remote position

raw.description:
About Citrine Informatics

At Citrine, we’re using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enable our customers to usher in the next generation of sustainable, high-performing materials and chemicals.

Our customers love what we do:

“We understand our own laboratory more than before. It’s fun to work in this way.”

We’re the leader in AI for materials and chemicals. 10 of the top 20 chemical companies have trusted us as their AI provider and we have created more than $100 Million dollars in value for our customers to date. Our no-code SaaS platform empowers product developers to accelerate their work using chemically-aware data management and AI tools.

Citrine regularly wins awards for innovation and sustainability, earning spots on the CB Insights AI 100 list and the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies in the US. Our customers include leading organizations such as LyondellBasell, Evonik, Grace, Avery Dennison, and Syensqo. We also collaborate with researchers from world-renowned institutions on cutting-edge research at the intersection of AI and the physical sciences.

Our team is exceptional, eager to grow and learn from each other. Team members work remotely throughout North America and Europe driven by our sustainability mission. We’re growing quickly, and looking for the best to join us!

About the Role

Data & AI Research Engineering (DARE) is a uniquely interdisciplinary team working at the intersection of materials science, machine learning, and software engineering. We are responsible for researching, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining the core materials-aware machine learning functionality that powers the Citrine Platform. We collaborate extensively across the company — other teams rely on us throughout the product lifecycle to translate ideas to math to code and back again.

Example projects:

  • Improve and maintain our core Python libraries that enable our users to apply machine learning to solve the world’s most important materials science problems at an industrial scale
  • Collaborate with our Product team to shape the future of our AI capabilities and support our customer’s unique use cases
  • Improve the interpretability of machine learning models and develop tools to communicate that information to users
  • Improve our inverse design capabilities that efficiently explore complex parameter spaces that characterize real-world materials synthesis problems
  • Collaborate with our External Research and Development (ERD) team to write and publish papers related to the work we’re doing
  • Develop new methods to quantify uncertainty in machine learning predictions

Responsibilities

  • Writing and maintaining Python ML code
  • Researching, prototyping, and developing new materials-aware ML models and features
  • Collaborating closely with other engineers, frequently reviewing code and best practices
  • Mentoring other developers
  • Designing high-performance, scalable ML systems
  • Testing & analyzing the impact and performance of models
  • Working in a multi-functional team on features from concept to delivery

Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years of professional experience or 3+ years with MS/PhD in a quantitative discipline
  • Proficient in a programming language such as Python or Scala
  • Proven history of implementing AI solutions for customers, with quantifiable results
  • Experience solving scientific problems with computational techniques
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and design choices to any audience
  • In depth knowledge of how core ML algorithms work and their design (random forest, neural networks, etc.)
  • Ability to write tested, production-quality code
  • Legally eligible to work in the United States

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with or a degree in Materials Science
  • Extensive knowledge of statistics
  • Experience with LLMs
    • Bonus points if you’ve pre-trained or fine-tuned foundation models!
  • SQL and relational databases
  • Close integration with various AWS services (S3, RDS, SQS, etc)
  • Published papers that establish you as a domain expert in AI/ML, NLP, or CV

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, or national origin. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Accommodations

Citrine is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email us at or inform your recruiter if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Core Values

Citrine Informatics recognizes that its most valuable asset is its people. We have created our set of Core Values to encourage, support, and invest in our team as they work to innovate and support a more sustainable world. Our Core Values reflect our ongoing commitment to continuously invest in nurturing our talent and our people-first approach to conducting business.

- We take pride in and recognize the successes and growth of ourselves and our colleagues. We support each other in our growth.

- We prototype and collect data to make good decisions. We question that data and are constantly iterating to find the best solution.

- We are all owners of Citrine and make decisions like owners. We work autonomously with personal and organizational accountability.

- We commit to building a diverse and inclusive community within Citrine and actively promote equity and belonging.

- We are tirelessly committed to creating value for our customers.

- We exist to help our customers accelerate the development of sustainable products that are critical to the future of both our planet and our industry.

Compensation and Pay Transparency

At Citrine, we want your path to career growth to be transparent, straightforward, fair, and easily accessible -- starting with your application and interview process. The annual salary range listed below reflects the level we are considering for this position (please note that there may be unique situations where you may fall outside of this range). Where you fall within the range will depend on how your experience and skills align with our internal leveling system as we learn more about you throughout the interview process.

$182,000 USD - $210,000 USD

*Range(s) listed are for full-time employees based in the United States only.

Our Benefits(for exempt, full-time employees based within the United States)

401k with matching up to 4%

Medical, vision, dental insurance (we pay 100% of your premium and 75% of your dependents)

Company-paid Life and Disability insurance

FSA and HSA plans

Equity options within the company

12 weeks of paid parental leave

Flexible PTO on top of our 15 paid company holidays (includes your birthday!)

Free financial counseling

$600 tech allowance

Monthly $75 phone reimbursement

$5,000 annual continuing educational allowance
