raw.description:
About Us
Gravity Global is the world’s most awarded marketing consultancy specialising in brands operating in complex markets. Led by strategy, innovation, technology, data, and creativity, we create brand-and-demand marketing programmes that drive transformational growth for our clients.
With 14 wholly owned offices across the US, Europe and APAC, and our Global Talent Hubs in emerging markets, you can build a truly global career in a rapidly scaling organisation that’s shaping the future of marketing.
At Gravity Global, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We’re a collective of creative thinkers, strategic storytellers, and data-driven innovators united by one mission – to deliver exceptional work that makes an impact. We’re growing fast – across continents and disciplines – and we’re looking for passionate individuals who want to make a difference: for our clients, our teams, and the world around us.

The Role
This is an exciting opportunity to help build and shape the future direction of Gravity Global’s largest growth area in a rapidly expanding network agency. The role is available fully remote but the ideal candidate has access to London or Norwich for key meetings and events. You will work with our global client services teams based in the US, London, Oxford and our performance marketing arm based in Norwich.
Reporting into and mentored by a Director and Head of Biddable. The role will provide room for growth and the opportunity to be involved in diverse and challenging projects across our global agency network.

Key Responsibilities

  • To manage and optimise Paid Search and Paid Social campaigns for a broad portfolio of clients across a range of industry sectors
  • Managing media budgets in excess of £1m per month.
  • To create effective paid digital strategies for client campaigns, using desktop research and industry tools to create compelling media plans, including channel budget allocations, creative approach, and performance forecasts.
  • To identify further opportunities for existing clients across additional networks, channels and areas where spend can be increased, and work with relevant colleagues to present these to clients.
  • Manage and mentor junior team members.
  • Own daily campaign monitoring, optimisation and budget management outputs.
  • Be involved in new business development by having an input into or preparing proposals wherever required
  • As a team, generate regular client reports and contribute to campaign review documents with accurate data, clear analysis, and recommendations.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

You will have;
  • Proven ability to effectively manage Paid Search and Paid Social channels across Google Ads and paid social and/or programmatic platforms.
  • Experience in setting up new accounts to include account uploads, tracking / goal set-up and report template creation.
  • Experience in using reporting mechanisms to monitor and derive actionable insights from your paid digital campaigns.
  • Excellent, persuasive verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to confidently speak to clients.
  • Confident in using Microsoft Office applications: Excel to prepare and analyse data; PowerPoint and Word to prepare clear reports and recommendations.

What we can offer:

While specific benefits may vary by region due to cultural norms, all team members at Gravity Global can expect a supportive, inclusive, and rewarding environment designed to help you do your best work and grow your career.
Key aspects of being part of the Gravity Global community:
  • 💰 Competitive Reward & Pay – we recognise and value your contribution with fair and competitive rewards aligned to local market practices, designed to celebrate excellence and support long-term success.
  • 🚀 Career Growth & Development – we believe development is ongoing, not annual. Through our Continuous Performance Management (CPM) process, which includes regular feedback and coaching, we help you refine your skills, celebrate your achievements, and plan for future success enabling you to reach your full potential.
  • 🤝 Collaboration – be part of a cross-functional, global team that values sharing insights, ideas, and best practices to drive collective success.
  • 🎓 Professional Development – we invest in you through ongoing training and learning programmes designed to expand your expertise and confidence.
  • 🌴 Work-Life Balance – while we expect dedication to client success, we also value your wellbeing, offering flexible working arrangements and plentiful paid time off.
  • 🎉 Community & Recognition – we celebrate our people through social and team-building events, recognise length of service and life milestones, and appreciate individual contributions through our Gravity Gratitude ‘kudos’ recognition programme.
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family Support – we understand family matters and our people benefit from family-friendly policies such as parental leave, and access to wellbeing resources to help you balance work and family life.
  • 🌱 Purpose & Belonging – we are committed to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) principles, fostering a workplace where positive impact matters. Our people are encouraged to get involved in employee resource groups that champion wellbeing, sustainability and culture.
Important Disclosure:
At Gravity Global, we believe in recognising every team member’s contribution. Your total rewards package – including salary and benefits – will align with country specific labor laws and our company policies. We’ll walk you through all the details during the offer stage.
Gravity Global is an equal opportunities employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion, age, sexuality, disability and other protected status as required by applicable law.
If your experience doesn't align perfectly with the job criteria, but you meet some of the criteria and are excited about the role and Gravity, please don't be put off applying! We would encourage you to apply for the role as you may be just the right person for this role or other roles.

Senior Paid Media Specialist (Remote)

About the Role

Do you have a strategic mind for paid media, a drive to deliver meaningful business growth, and a commitment to creating uncommonly effective campaigns?

Etna Interactive, a digital marketing agency with a 25-year legacy of helping elective healthcare practices grow, is seeking a full-time, fully remote Senior Paid Media Specialist with exceptional communication skills and expertise in paid media strategy and execution. This remote role is open to candidates residing in California, Arizona, Michigan, Washington, Colorado, or Georgia.

We’re looking for a talented individual to join our team and drive client success through data-driven paid media campaigns. In this role, you will collaborate closely with our Client Success, Creative, Sales, and Strategy teams to forecast, develop, manage, optimize, and report on campaigns that deliver measurable results. As an analytical thinker and experienced specialist, you’ll maximize ROI, align campaigns with client goals, and continually innovate to stay ahead in the paid media landscape.

About You

You are detail-oriented, self-motivated, and thrive managing multiple accounts with varying budgets. Your technical expertise, combined with a passion for learning, will support our team’s success. Since many of our clients are in the medical field, adaptability and a willingness to learn new industry concepts are essential as you balance complex campaign strategies with a commitment to delivering outstanding results.

Why should you choose Etna?

  • Values Driven Culture
    • We live by our values, encouraging flexibility, work-life balance, and an inclusive environment.
  • Commitment to Growth
    • With our progressive PTO system and a focus on development, we ensure you have time to recharge and grow.
  • Great People
    • You’ll be part of a collaborative, talented, and fun team that embodies curiosity, fairness, and lifelong learning.
  • Outstanding Benefits
    • We offer 100% employer-sponsored medical coverage, 401(K) with matching, and employer-sponsored long-term disability insurance.

Why should Etna choose you?

Because our mid-sized agency has made a big name for itself in the medical marketing space, our clients expect and truly deserve the attention of an experienced professional with:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, or Business (preferred) and 4+ years of relevant experience managing paid media campaigns, including at least 2 years in an agency setting.
  • Skilled in full-funnel account management across PPC, Paid Social, and Programmatic/Display channels.
  • Solid technical foundation, with expertise in Unbounce, PPC Management Software, SpyFu, Excel, Ahrefs, and certifications in Google AdWords, Google Analytics, and Meta.
  • Exceptional communication and organization skills; can clearly communicate data insights, client updates, and campaign recommendations.
  • Enjoys mentoring junior team members and is comfortable engaging with clients on calls when needed.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA is a plus, given our focus on healthcare.

Role Responsibilities

As a Senior Paid Media Specialist, you’ll:

  • Learn and apply our predictive modelling protocols to client campaigns to minimize risk and proactively shape campaigns for success
  • Lead the development of strategic paid media campaigns, aligning them with client goals to deliver high-impact results.
  • Drive continuous optimization, managing and enhancing campaigns across platforms to maximize client ROI.
  • Consult with clients and teams to ensure paid media efforts integrate with broader marketing strategies, serving as a knowledgeable and reliable client partner.
  • Mentor junior team members and collaborate across departments, sharing expertise and fostering a high-performing team environment.
  • Monitor and report on KPIs and adjust strategies based on performance insights.

While a strong skillset and innate intelligence will get you in the door, a kind personality, and the ability to fit in with the culture at Etna are necessary traits of a successful applicant.

Compensation

The estimated salary range for this role is $72,000 - $85,000annually. However, it is important to note that compensation may vary depending on several factors, primarily including the candidate's level of experience and qualifications.

At Etna Interactive, we strive to offer competitive compensation packages that align with industry standards and reflect the value of the skills and expertise that candidates bring to the table. The final compensation offered will be determined based on a comprehensive assessment of factors including (but not limited to) relevant work experience, educational background, demonstrated skills and abilities, and the specific requirements of the position.

Application Instructions

To APPLY, familiarize yourself with our company, our clients, and the work we do and then Upload at your résumé and a cover letter (PDF preferred) to .

Etna Interactive provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Etna Interactive complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Do you have a gift for turning a 45-minute conversation into a story someone will want to frame?

Fusion Growth Partners is looking for a skilled narrative writer to interview our business partners and their clients, then transform what we learn into short, compelling personal stories — plus polished resumes and sharp, error-free proofreading. If you love people's stories almost as much as you love a clean sentence, keep reading.

About Fusion Growth PartnersFusion Growth Partners is a business incubator and accelerator. We partner directly with small business owners — real estate agents, in particular — and invest in their businesses to help them grow their customer base and build a stronger foundation. We do this through advanced business planning, proven systems and processes, a trained support team, and serious marketing resources. We're paid through licensing fees or a small percentage of our partners' successful transactions. As far as we know, no one else in the country does exactly what we do.

Want to see it in action? Watch a sample of our partner presentation:Learn more:

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Conduct friendly, structured video interviews with our partners and their clients to uncover the real story behind them — their background, their "why," and what makes them worth remembering
  • Turn those interviews into a polished, individual story letter that sounds like the person, not like a template
  • Draft and refine professional resumes based on the same interviews
  • Proofread a steady stream of documents daily for grammar, clarity, spelling, and tone
  • Keep every piece consistent with each partner's brand voice
  • Work closely with our Project Manager to stay on schedule and on-brief

Requirements

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Write clean, engaging English and can shift tone from formal (resumes) to warm and personal (story letters) without missing a beat
  • Have real experience in narrative writing, copywriting, biography writing, or a closely related field
  • Can run a conversation, not just conduct an interrogation — you know how to draw out the good stuff on a video call
  • Have a sharp eye for typos and inconsistencies that other people scroll right past
  • Can manage your own time and hit deadlines without someone standing over your shoulder
  • Have a reliable internet connection and a quiet space for video calls

Nice to Have

  • A portfolio or writing samples you're proud to share
  • Experience writing resumes
  • Familiarity with real estate, small business, or entrepreneurship (not required — we'll teach you what you need to know about our world)

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, flexible part-time schedule (5–10 hrs/week)
  • Paid per completed project — the faster and more efficient you are, the more you earn per hour worked
  • A genuine path to more hours and responsibility as you prove yourself
  • A small, supportive team that actually reads your drafts and gives real feedback

How Pay Works

  • You're paid per completed project, not by the clock. Each project type has a flat rate based on the average time it takes to complete at a standard hourly rate — so efficient work is rewarded, not penalized.
  • There's a 30-day probation period where project rates are lower while we confirm fit and workflow. Full rates kick in once probation is complete.

raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Payroll Associate processes payroll for the GuideWell family of companies, ensuring accurate and timely payments in compliance with Federal and State regulations. As a first-contact resource, the Payroll Associate provides customer service for employee payroll, time and labor inquiries through phone, email, and help desk channels, resolving routine issues and escalating complex cases.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Payroll Processing & Data Entry

Perform transactional and administrative data entry, including, but not limited to: benefit corrections, severance, PTO donations, deduction set up, direct deposits, duplicate W2s and paystubs, garnishments, writs, levies, child support, bankruptcies, military differential, leave coding, manual checks, subpoenas, workers comp statements, security requests, verifications, as required while ensuring accurate employee earnings.

Payroll Audit & Compliance

Responsible for working pre-payroll duties in preparation for the upcoming pay period including, but not limited to: employee pay status changes, auditing of timecards, validation of special payments, and auditing of variances in pay. Performs functions needed to FUNCTIONSpayroll in compliance with State and Federal regulatory requirements and internal Corporate Policies as it relates to employee’s pay.

Employee Service & Issue Resolution

Serve as first contact for payroll, time and labor, and web clock inquiries via phone, email, or help desk, escalating as appropriate. Research and resolve paycheck questions, including being able to explain the calculation of net pay to an employee. Provide information on employee self-service, company policies, and government regulations.

Payment & Account Management

Manage paycheck distribution issues and communicate corrections to employees. Resolve issues and process repayments as needed.

Process Improvement & Documentation

Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for payroll operations. Identify and recommend process improvements. Provide feedback on employee issues to management.

Team Collaboration & Support

Work collaboratively within the team to drive improvements and consistency in payroll processes. Support the integrity of employee records and coordinate with Payroll Accounting as needed.

Required Qualifications:

4+ years related work experience.

Experience with HRIS/Payroll systems

High school diploma or GED

Basic knowledge of calculating a paycheck from gross to net pay

Proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Strong interpersonal, verbal (phone) and written communication, as well as active listening skills to handle a volume of inbound inquiries from employees; this position continually requires demonstrated poise, tact and diplomacy.

Preferred Qualifications:
General knowledge of Payroll & HR policies and procedures.

Associate or bachelor’s degree in related field.

Experience working with Oracle Cloud HCM Payroll module and ADP Payment Solutions.

General Physical Demands
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.


What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will be at the heart of GuideWell’s vision – to lead the nation in transforming health through compassionate, connected, and technology-enabled care that delivers personalized value and empowered living.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Hourly Pay Range: $24 - $38

Typical Hourly Pay Range: $24 - $30

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Basic Function:

This is a balanced, digitally native creative role built for a marketing team shifting toward digital marketing and demand generation. The Digital Content Creator & Multimedia Designer creates the visual content that powers our brand and sales efforts — graphic design for flyers, presentations, live-event and tradeshow materials, and sales collateral, coupled with video production for YouTube and social. Graphic design and video are equal, core parts of the role, supported by brand work and digital/web design.

Beyond production, this person helps uphold and evolve our brand across every channel, translates complex tax and engineering topics into clear and engaging visual stories, and writes sharp short-form copy such as headlines, hooks, and captions. We're looking for a dynamic, driven creator who solves problems, builds fast, and uses today's tools — including AI — to work efficiently and punch above their weight. This person partners closely with our Demand Generation Manager to turn campaign strategy into high-performing creative.

This is a fast-paced, high-output position ideal for a creator who thrives on variety, moves comfortably between the editing timeline and the design canvas, and believes great content is both beautiful and measurable.

Position's Intention:

To conceptualize, design, and produce visual content across graphic design and video that aligns with our brand, deepens engagement across digital platforms, and directly supports sales enablement, live events, and demand-generation goals.

Success Measurements:

Performance is measured by the impact of the work on the brand, sales, and audience engagement — not activity alone. Representative measures include:

  • Quality and consistency of design across collateral, presentations, event materials, and every channel.
  • Turnaround and reliability on sales-enablement, live-event, and internal requests.
  • Video performance: views, watch time / retention, subscriber growth on YouTube, and completion / save rates on short-form (Reels, Shorts, TikTok).
  • Content output and cadence: reliable delivery of the hub-and-spoke content engine (a hub video repurposed into a batch of short-form cuts).
  • Contribution to demand-gen campaigns: engagement and conversion on the creative you produce.
Essential Functions:

This is a balanced role. Graphic design and sales-support work and video/multimedia are both core, roughly equal parts of the job.

Graphic Design & Sales Enablement

  • Design sales-support and marketing collateral — flyers, one-pagers, brochures, sell sheets, and case studies — that help the sales team communicate our value.
  • Build and polish professional PowerPoint presentations and well-designed Microsoft Word documents that are clear, compelling, and on-brand.
  • Create graphics for live events and tradeshows — pull-up banners, tablecloths, backdrops, signage, QR codes, and flyers — with full understanding of the print process from design to shipment.
  • Partner with the sales team to keep materials current, consistent, and ready when they need them.

Video & Multimedia Content

  • Edit long-form video for YouTube — including SlashTax podcast episodes and educational content — with clean cuts, pacing, captions/subtitles, chapters, intros/outros, thumbnails, and on-screen graphics.
  • Produce short-form vertical video (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) by cutting and repurposing hub content into a steady batch of clips (the hub-and-spoke model).
  • Create motion graphics and animation for social, web, and presentations.
  • Support podcast/studio production: basic lighting and audio setup, framing, and post-production cleanup (color, sound leveling, noise reduction).
  • Write short, effective hooks, captions, titles, and descriptions that earn attention and support each platform's algorithm.

Brand & Creative Development

  • Monitor, maintain, and evolve the visual and verbal brand identity — consistency in imagery, design, tone, and language across every channel and touchpoint.
  • Create and maintain brand assets and templates across digital and print.
  • Continuously scout new formats, platforms, and technology (including AI-assisted tools) to evolve how the brand shows up.

Digital & Web Design

  • Design the look and feel of landing pages and web assets that support marketing campaigns — visually compelling, on-brand, and built to convert.
  • Create developer-ready design mockups (e.g., in Figma) and hand them off to the development team for build — this is a visual design role, not a front-end coding role.
  • In partnership with the Demand Generation Manager, design ad creative for paid social and LinkedIn, email campaigns, and digital ads sized to platform specs.
  • Produce social graphics tailored to each platform and audience, and refine creative based on campaign feedback.

Other duties as assigned.


Requirements

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years in graphic design and content creation, with a portfolio showing marketing and sales collateral, presentations, event materials, and video work.
  • A portfolio demonstrating both polished design work and effective video is strongly preferred.

Graphic Design & Creative Expertise (must-have)

  • Command of design fundamentals — color theory, typography, composition, and visual storytelling.
  • Strong capability across digital and print, including production-ready asset development.
  • Proven ability to design polished sales collateral, presentations (PowerPoint), and live-event / tradeshow materials.
  • Ability to generate campaign-aligned concepts and translate complex topics into clear visuals.

Video & Multimedia (must-have)

  • Solid video editing skill in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects; comfort with short-form tools (e.g., CapCut, Descript).
  • Strong understanding of video storytelling, audience engagement, and platform best practices, including editing pace, thumbnail strategy, captioning and content optimization for YouTube and short-form social platforms.
  • Working knowledge of production basics: lighting, audio capture, color correction, and sound editing; motion graphics / animation capability.

Digital & Web Design

  • Understanding of UX/UI design principles — visual hierarchy, mobile-first layouts, and clean, conversion-minded design.
  • Ability to produce developer-ready mockups (e.g., in Figma) for the dev team to build. (Front-end coding is not required.)
  • Experience designing landing pages and digital assets that look great and convert.

Marketing & Demand-Gen Support

  • Solid understanding of digital marketing and how content and creative move an audience through the funnel.
  • Able to partner with a Demand Generation Manager, turning campaign strategy into high-performing creative.
  • Familiarity with paid social / LinkedIn ad specs, email, and landing-page best practices; uses engagement data to sharpen creative.

Software & Tools

  • Adobe Creative Suite — Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign.
  • Figma (or equivalent) and short-form video tools (CapCut, Descript).
  • Microsoft Office Suite, with the ability to produce well-designed Word documents and PowerPoint decks.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted design, video, and content tools to work faster and produce more — a core expectation, not a bonus.
  • Familiarity with content management systems.

Work Style & Interpersonal

  • Proactive, self-directed, and organized; able to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a track record of taking projects from concept to final delivery.
  • Collaborative communicator, open to feedback, and committed to continuous growth.

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life, Whole Life, Vol Life, Short-Term Disability, LTD, Accident, Critical Illness, Hospitalization, Legal, Theft ID, Doctegrity, Pet, 401k, PTO and much more!

Job Summary

Equiti is seeking qualified Video Medical Interpreters to work remotely from any U.S.-based location. As a vital member of our interpretation team, you will facilitate clear, accurate, and culturally competent communication between healthcare providers and Limited English Proficient (LEP) patients. You will serve as a professional conduit for information and, when appropriate, a cultural broker to ensure full understanding. Interpreters support both healthcare and educational settings via audio and video modalities.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Interpret accurately and completely between source and target language for hospitals, clinics, and other facilities nationwide.

  • Ensure full comprehension by adjusting register as needed for the LEP patient.

  • Maintain strict confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and professional standards.

  • Adhere to Equiti’s quality policy and promote excellent customer service to clients and patients.

  • Establish and maintain positive, professional interactions with all users.

  • Act as a cultural broker when needed to clarify cultural nuances or misunderstandings.

  • Demonstrate camera awareness during VRI sessions, ensuring proper posture, voice projection, and presence.

  • Maintain required certifications and continue professional development.

  • Adapt to changing technology, platforms, and protocols as needed.

  • Participate actively in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in remote medical interpreting (required).

  • 40+ hours of interpreter training (e.g., Bridging the Gap or equivalent).

  • Medical interpretation certification (e.g., CMI, CHI) preferred.

  • Documented fluency in English and at least one other language.

  • Equal command of medical, educational, and social service terminology in both languages.

  • Proven understanding of the NCIHC Code of Ethics and Standards of Practice.

  • Strong customer service, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.

  • Proven ability to learn and operate proprietary and common software tools.

  • Ability to adjust interpretation register appropriately.

  • Demonstrated critical thinking and a teamwork mindset.

  • Experience serving individuals from diverse cultural and socio-economic backgrounds.

Technical Requirements

  • A HIPAA-compliant home workspace (chair, desk, privacy).

  • Dedicated, high-speed wired internet (no Wi-Fi):

    • Minimum Download Speed: 10 Mbps

    • Minimum Upload Speed: 3 Mbps

    • Latency: ≤ 100ms

    • Jitter: ≤ 30ms

    • Packet Loss: ≤ 1%

  • Company-provided laptop computer running Windows 10+ with a minimum of 8GB RAM (no tablets or phones).

  • Company-provided noise-cancelling USB-wired headset with built-in microphone (no Bluetooth/wireless).

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As Chief of Staff to the CHRO, you'll serve as a force multiplier for the People organization's most senior leader, ensuring priorities are advanced, time is focused on the highest-impact areas, and voice is amplified internally and externally. You'll own the operating rhythm for the People leadership team and lead critical initiatives from conception through execution, proactively resolving problems before they reach the CHRO.

What you'll do:

  • Own the CHRO's operating cadence by managing weekly and quarterly leadership meetings, setting clear agendas, driving decisions, and ensuring follow-ups are completed.
  • Lead critical cross-functional initiatives and engagements on behalf of the CHRO, acting as her stand-in when needed in key meetings and decisions.
  • Develop compelling content and narratives including meeting decks, org-wide emails, social media posts, and speaking engagement materials that amplify the CHRO's voice.
  • Proactively identify and resolve issues before they escalate, synthesizing ambiguity into clear recommendations for executive decision-making.
  • Represent the CHRO's interests and point of view across the organization, ensuring alignment and advancing People team priorities with cross-functional stakeholders.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 7+ years of experience, including management consulting, business operations, strategy, or a chief of staff capacity supporting senior executives.
  • Proven ability to synthesize ambiguous, complex topics into clear executive-ready recommendations, narratives, and communications across formats (decks, emails, social content).
  • Track record of driving cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, managing multiple workstreams simultaneously with clear accountability and follow-through.
  • Knowledge of crypto or demonstrated enthusiasm for the space with willingness to immerse yourself in the ecosystem.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

description: As part of our Customer Success Team, the Customer Support Specialist plays a pivotal role in ensuring effective support of both our customers and their employees.

raw.title: Customer Support Specialist
raw.excerpt: As part of our Customer Success Team, the Customer Support Specialist plays a pivotal role in ensuring effective support of both our customers and their employees.
raw.description:
As part of our Customer Success Team, the Customer Support Specialist plays a pivotal role in ensuring effective support of both our customers and their employees. You’ll be on the front line of the customer experience, providing timely, thoughtful, and effective support.

You’ll resolve technical issues, troubleshoot platform challenges, and provide general product guidance, while acting as a liaison between support, Customer Success/Onboarding and Product/Development teams.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, is comfortable navigating technology, and can communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences. Above all, you’ll help ensure our customers feel heard, supported, and confident that their questions are in capable hands.

About Us: Bucketlist Rewards provides a leading B2B SaaS solution that allows organizations of all sizes to introduce effective rewards and recognition programs to its workforce. Our goal is to provide companies with an easy-to-use web platform that enables employers to reward team members in a meaningful way that matters to them, while achieving great business results and building better organizational cultures. When it comes to great company culture, the Bucketlist team walks the talk and we are proud to be Great Place to Work certified!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deliver a reliable customer support experience:
    • Own incoming customer and employee inquiries across support channels, providing timely, clear, and effective assistance while working within established service level agreements (SLA)
    • Consistently achieving KPI of Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
    • Contributing to and successfully achieving all team and department KPIs
    • Take ownership of support requests from initial investigation through resolution, keeping customers informed and ensuring tickets continue moving forward.
    • Keeping your knowledge up-to-date with new product feature launches and product improvements
    • Understanding our customer’s usage of our product to identify support trends, and provide more informed support.
    • Focusing on effectively delivering our Customer Promise including Customer Journey Ownership, Proactive Communication, and Ease of Escalation.
  • Technical Support Knowledge:
    • Reproduce reported issues, investigate system behaviour, and identify root causes. Resolve issues through platform or system configuration, available workarounds, or by clearly documenting and reporting confirmed product defects.
    • Take initiative to investigate and resolve technical issues independently, using available tools, documentation, and resources before escalating to Tier 2, while recognizing when an issue requires additional technical expertise
  • Process Improvement:
    • Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen support processes, documentation, and operational efficiency
    • Maintain and improve Help Center resources and collaborate cross-functionally to implement improvements that create a better experience for customers and internal teams
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement improvements and streamline operations.
  • Operational Requests:
    • Fulfill administrative and platform requests for internal teams in a timely manner, balancing these operational tasks alongside client support to ensure all deliverables consistently meet established timelines and SLAs.
  • Redemption Support:
    • Providing redemption team coverage as required. Assisting in order fulfillment, including purchasing rewards, troubleshooting redemption and vendor issues, and record keeping

Required Skills for Success:

  • You have 2+ years of direct experience supporting non-technical end users in a high-volume environment and you're genuinely good at it. Preferably SaaS customer support experience.
  • Troubleshooting instincts: you diagnose the why behind an issue, not just the symptom, and you document it clearly enough for engineering to act on
  • Great Communication Skills: Ability to explain a technical workflow to a non-technical audience and continue active follow up on tickets both in written format and over the phone
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills: adept at navigating a fast-paced environment with precision, attention to detail, and a focus on consistently meeting or exceeding SLAs and KPIs.
  • CRM experience: Experience using CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Support ticketing/helpdesk platform experience

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Technical support experience: Learning and/or already utilizing basic terminal/command-lines, SQL, and/or python in day-to-day workflows
  • Technical Project Tracking Experience- Learning and/or already utilizing tools like Jira, Confluence, and/or Grafana in day-to-day workflows
  • HRIS/SFTP system experience: as our system integrates with HRIS/SFTP systems, it is always nice to have experience with at least one
  • Experience using and/or implementing AI tools and solutions for support

The Perks:

  • Growth Opportunities: Join a growing company where you’ll be part of a high performing team with lots of potential.
  • Remote Work: We are a distributed workplace (100% remote). This position is open to anyone residing and able to work in Canada on a remote basis.
  • Wellness Days: In addition to paid vacation days, we offer flexible paid time off to fit individual needs.
  • Comprehensive benefits package: Includes health, dental, vision care, EFAP and more.
  • Annual Bucketlist Benefit: An additional paid day off and $$ to spend to help check items off your own bucket list!
  • Home Office and Learning & Development Benefits: Support for your home workspace and funding to grow your skills.
  • Rewards and Recognition: We walk the talk! We’ll help you achieve not just your career goals, but your personal goals as well!

Compensation: Anticipated Salary Range for this role is $60,000 to $70,000 CAD plus performance based bonuses. The final offer will consider factors such as your expertise, role alignment, and internal equity.

At Bucketlist Rewards, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We believe that varied perspectives drive innovation and creativity, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. We encourage individuals from underrepresented groups to apply, as we strive to build a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve. We are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best work.

AI in Our Hiring Process:

At Bucketlist Rewards, we use AI-assisted tools to help review and prioritize applications. AI screening is used to help sort resumes, with human review involved at every stage of our hiring process.

In accordance with Ontario's Employment Standards Act, we're committed to being transparent about how AI is used in our hiring.

Salary: $60,000 to $70,000 annually

raw.description:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

About us:

We are Publitas! We’re a remote-first, fast-growing SaaS company helping brands turn static content into digital discovery experiences that drive results.

We’re not about busywork, hierarchy, or hand-holding. We hire sharp minds, trust them fully, and measure success by real results, not noise. If you thrive in autonomy, challenge, and high ownership, you’ll love it here.

This role is for you if you…

  • Get excited by taking ownership and figuring things out proactively

  • Thrive in a remote, async, fast-paced environment

  • Are striving to deliver impact, not just running tasks

  • Think in systems but execute with creativity

  • Are direct, collaborative, and have a growth mindset

This role is NOT for you if you…

  • Need layers of process or someone to constantly tell you what to do

  • Prefer “business as usual” over change

  • Want a team where mediocre is okay

  • Have never worked remotely and think async means “lonely”

  • Are waiting for permission instead of taking initiative

The work you’ll do…

As a Senior Internal IT Engineer atPublitas, you’ll build and scale the internal technology foundation that enables our distributed teams to work securely, efficiently, and without friction.
You’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with operational ownership and process thinking to improve the reliability and maturity of our internal IT environment.

You will:

  • Own and continuously improve our internal IT landscape, ensuring secure, reliable, and scalable day-to-day operations across endpoints, SaaS tooling, identity, and access management.

  • Drive operational maturity by creating structure, improving workflows, and reducing manual or reactive support work across the organization.

  • Lead and coordinate internal IT projects, from onboarding automation and device management to security improvements and tooling rollouts.

  • Act as a trusted technical partner for employees and stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, prioritization, and follow-through across distributed teams.

  • Improve our security posture by strengthening access controls, endpoint management, compliance processes, and operational best practices.

  • Manage and optimize our SaaS ecosystem, balancing usability, security, cost-efficiency, and maintainability.

  • Create scalable internal processes and documentation that enable autonomy, consistency, and operational resilience as the company grows.

  • Contribute to company-wide operational readiness initiatives, including audits, compliance efforts, and business continuity improvements.

What you bring…

  • 5+ years of experience in Internal IT, IT Operations, or Systems Administration within modern SaaS environments.

  • Strong experience with identity and access management, endpoint management, SaaS administration, and security best practices.

  • Hands-on experience managing distributed or remote-first environments.

  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills — you can independently drive initiatives from planning to execution.

  • A process-oriented mindset focused on scalability, automation, and operational clarity.

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • The ability to balance hands-on execution with longer-term operational improvements.

What We Provide to Help You Win…

  • A competitive salary

  • 25 vacation days + your local national holidays

  • A top-tier MacBook and remote-ready gear

  • Monthly wellness budget to invest in your health

  • Co-Working allowance

  • Events, training, or courses that directly and primarily contribute to your work at Publitas

  • Free books on Kindle and Audible

  • Free Publitas Swag (merchandise)

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.
